text: On the same arena, the young martial hero slightly raises his head, revealing a confident smile beneath the conical bamboo hat. He raises his right hand into a defensive stance and says softly, "Please give me your guidance." The frame is a low-angle medium shot, with the camera slowly crabbing left (Crab Left), focusing on the character's expression, centered composition.
quote: Please give me your guidance.

text: The same platform, the mysterious stranger lands with his back to the camera. Lin Feng, the eldest disciple in a blue-green robe with a goatee, strides in from the left carrying a long staff and stands in front of the elder to shield him. Low-angle upward shot, rapidly pulling back to a wide shot. The elder clutches his chest and warns gravely: "Lin Feng, be careful, this man is no ordinary opponent!"
quote: Lin Feng, be careful, this man is no ordinary opponent!

text: Inside the cave, a young man in armor with a high ponytail holds open an orange magic circle with both hands, firmly bracing against a falling boulder. He shouts anxiously: "This boulder is a massive talisman, attack together!" Low-angle medium shot rapidly pushes in to a close-up, full of tension.
quote: This boulder is a massive talisman, attack together!

text: On a xianxia ice plain where the cold wind is biting and giant ice crystals tower upward, the sky is overcast. The senior brother, with white hair tied in a high ponytail and wearing dark-blue heavy armor, stands with his hands clasped behind his back, his expression cold; the junior brother, with black hair falling to his shoulders and wearing silver armor over a white base, stands not far away, his expression resolute, angrily shouting: "No, Senior Brother, I don't agree!" Before his words have finished, the junior brother suddenly stomps the ground, and the ice surface instantly shatters and cracks open; using the force, he launches himself into the air. The image uses a low-angle upward shot; as the junior brother leaps up, the camera rapidly rises upward and performs a 360-degree orbiting rotation, revealing several streams of sharp sword qi emitting blue light instantly condensing beside him, with a majestic momentum.
quote: No, Senior Brother, I don't agree!

text: Still on the ice plain amid wind and snow, the senior brother stands unmoving in the aftershock of the explosion, his expression icy, shouting sternly: "My heart and my actions are both in accord with the Heavenly Dao; my conscience is clear!" He grabs at the void with his right hand, and a black-iron spear wrapped in black energy appears out of thin air; holding the spear in one hand, he sweeps it violently forward, sending a terrifying black shockwave surging out. The shot first cuts to a close-up of the senior brother's eyes, then the camera violently pulls back and turns into a Dutch-angle shot, accompanied by an intense sense of vibration, showing the enormous destructive power as the spear sweeps out.
quote: My heart and my actions are both in accord with the Heavenly Dao; my conscience is clear!

text: In the same ice plain, facing the black shockwave sweeping toward him, the junior brother holds his sword with both hands in front of him to block it, but is driven back by the immense impact, his feet sliding rapidly across the ice and plowing out two deep grooves. The senior brother holds the spear and charges in pursuit close to the ground, and the giant ice crystals along the way burst apart one after another; he says in a low voice: "Junior Brother, you've improved quite a bit." The shot uses a low-angle lateral tracking shot, moving parallel to the junior brother at extremely high speed, recording the motion of his difficult slide, then the camera smoothly cuts to a frontal view of the senior brother breaking through the ice in pursuit, the image filled with an intense sense of speed.
quote: Junior Brother, you've improved quite a bit.

text: Inside the bar at night, using an over-the-shoulder shot and over-the-shoulder composition, looking from behind the shoulder of the middle-aged fire captain in the dark green jacket toward the middle-aged firefighter in the black jacket; the middle-aged firefighter in the black jacket calmly looks at the other person and asks with a searching gaze, "How are you going to tell everyone?" The frame is a close shot, locked-off shot.
quote: How are you going to tell everyone?

text: On a modern American suburban street on a sunny summer day, the asphalt road, roadside greenbelt, and trees are clearly visible, with a white stucco house with an arched porch in the background and green hills in the distance. A thin middle-aged man with a beard, wearing a blue-and-white plaid shirt and jeans, stands under the house's porch, looking ahead in an annoyed and impatient way, quickly raises his left hand to scratch his head, then puts his hand back into his pants pocket, complaining that he does not want to walk home, even with a hint of resistance toward the idea of "going home." The image is a medium shot, eye-level static shot, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: going home.

text: Beside the same suburban street, an old ochre station wagon is parked at the roadside, and a middle-aged woman with short curly blond hair, wearing a floral dress and a beige cardigan, stands to one side of the front of the car, her expression serious and anxious; a boy with long blond hair, wearing a red-and-white striped T-shirt and blue overalls, has his back to her, leaning against the car and fiddling with the antenna, his expression unwilling. The two talk across the car, the woman urging him to walk home, while the boy mutters that he does not want to walk and asks back, "Why can't we drive? Everybody drives." The image is a medium wide shot, eye-level static shot, diagonal composition.
quote: Why can't we drive? Everybody drives.

text: Still on the same modern suburban street, the thin middle-aged man with a beard, wearing a blue-and-white plaid shirt and jeans, stands under the porch with both hands in his pants pockets, his expression still irritable and impatient, only nodding slightly, as if reluctantly accepting the arrangement in front of him, and says a helplessly persuasive line: "Come on, Sam, walk home for once in your life." The image is a medium shot, eye-level static shot, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Come on, Sam, walk home for once in your life.

text: Beside the same bright, sunny suburban street, the middle-aged woman with short curly blond hair, wearing a floral dress and a beige cardigan, continues speaking to the boy leaning beside the car, her expression resolute and her tone allowing no doubt, as if both soothing him and insisting, adding, "It won't kill you." The boy still has his back to her, leaning against the car without moving, and the atmosphere carries a slight sense of family tug-of-war. The image is a medium wide shot, eye-level static shot, diagonal composition.
quote: It won't kill you.

text: On a sheer, treacherous cliff wreathed in clouds and mist. The image begins in an extreme close-up, with a long emerald-green bamboo staff pressed hard against the throat of a coldly beautiful female assassin dressed in red-and-black period attire, her hair tied in a high ponytail. Her gaze is contemptuous; her fair fingers gently push the bamboo staff aside, and she says with a cold laugh, "You think someone like you can stop me?" Before the words have even left her mouth, the camera suddenly transitions with an extremely fast Whip Pan, revealing the refined knight-errant in white standing opposite her, staring her down and holding the bamboo staff. Immediately afterward, the female assassin flies backward in retreat, and the camera rapidly pulls back and rises upward with her (Crane Up & Pull Out), forming an overhead wide shot that reveals the tense atmosphere of the two facing off at the cliff's edge.
quote: You think someone like you can stop me?

text: In the same gloomy carnival grounds, the shot cuts to an over-the-shoulder angle from behind the female fortune-teller, looking slightly up at the drifter standing in front of her; he takes a small book with a red cover from his trouser pocket and hands it directly to her, his movement decisive, his expression calm. In the foreground, the female fortune-teller's blurred back of the head and the hand holding the cigarette can be seen, and the image uses a medium shot, an over-the-shoulder shot, and depth-of-field composition. The drifter asks her in a low voice, "Do you want to take the book back?"
quote: Do you want to take the book back?

text: Still in front of the carnival porch at dusk, the shot cuts to an over-the-shoulder angle from behind the drifter, eye-level on the seated female fortune-teller; holding the cigarette, she looks up at him, first slightly shakes her head to refuse the book, then gives a faint approving smile and says calmly, "No. Mm-hmm. You earned it yourself. You put in the effort." The shot is a medium shot, an over-the-shoulder shot, with depth-of-field composition, and the atmosphere is quiet with a faint sense of approval.
quote: No. Mm-hmm. You earned it yourself. You put in the effort.

text: In a modern rehearsal room on a sunny summer day, the space is not large; posters and decorative string lights hang on the wooden boards and unfinished walls, with a sofa, drum kit, speakers, and microphone stands placed nearby, making the environment look slightly cluttered yet full of musical atmosphere. A middle-aged white musician with dark brown hair and a goatee, wearing a gray plaid shirt, carries an electric guitar with a frustrated expression, stands in a medium shot, and says to the young white musician on the right: "It's fine, I don't want to perform anyway. Sam, don't be like this." After saying this, he takes the guitar off his body, turns around, and walks away toward the back left; the young white musician, wearing a printed dark green T-shirt, stands to the side and watches him helplessly, trying to persuade him. The image uses an eye-level locked-off shot with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: It's fine, I don't want to perform anyway. Sam, don't be like this.

text: In the same rehearsal room, the young white musician stands in front of the microphone, framed in a medium close-up with centered composition and an eye-level locked-off shot; he lowers his head to glance at the electric guitar in his hands, then raises his head and says helplessly into the microphone: "Come on, man. All right, all right, all right. All right, we'll sing this song." He then begins playing the guitar, his expression determined yet carrying a hint of compromise.
quote: Come on, man. All right, all right, all right. All right, we'll sing this song.

text: Still in the rehearsal room with a strong musical atmosphere, the middle-aged white musician returns to the microphone, presented in a medium close-up with centered composition and an eye-level locked-off shot; smiling, with a touch of smugness, he says to the young musician off-camera: "It really is a good song." Then, while playing the electric guitar, he gently sways his body with the rhythm, his expression gradually becoming absorbed and enjoying it.
quote: It really is a good song.

text: In the same rehearsal room, the young white musician continues standing in front of the microphone and playing the electric guitar, filmed in a medium close-up with centered composition and an eye-level locked-off shot; as he plays, he complains into the microphone with an expression that is both helpless and amused: "You bastard."
quote: You bastard.

text: A dim, dilapidated cyberpunk alley, blue light flickering. A red-hooded man in a suit (Akira) stands shoulder to shoulder with a burly man in blue; a young man in a cap (Yuki) hides behind them. A ragged figure approaches. Low-angle upward shot, the camera slowly pulls back from behind the figure and rises. Yuki asks nervously: "Senpai, kono machi ni wa itsumo konna yatsu ga?" (Senpai, has this town always had people like this?).
quote: Senpai, kono machi ni wa itsumo konna yatsu ga?

text: The same alley, Akira calm and composed. Medium shot, the camera performs a slow 180-degree orbiting dolly shot centered on him. He explains calmly: "Iya, demo arieru hanashi da. Kono machi wa jikken no eikyou de iroiro okoru. Tottemo fantajī na machi tte koto da." (No, but this is normal. Under the influence of the experiments, you could say it's a fantasy town.).
quote: Iya, demo arieru hanashi da. Kono machi wa jikken no eikyou de iroiro okoru. Tottemo fantajī na machi tte koto da.

text: The same alley, Yuki shrinking back with his arms crossed over his chest. Tight close-up, a rapidly tilted Dutch-angle composition accompanied by slight handheld shake. He quips in fear: "Horā no machigai desho!" (You mean a horror town!).
quote: Horā no machigai desho!

text: On a dim platform in a futuristic city at night, a black-haired female agent in tactical gear, her expression cold and stern, yanks off her glove with her teeth, revealing a mechanical arm. She quickly raises her arm and aims forward, shouting, "Surrender!" The image uses a low-angle upward shot; the camera rapidly pushes in to a close-up of her face, then whip-pans to the mechanical arm, filled with tension.
quote: Surrender!

text: Inside the dim great hall of the ancient castle, the white-haired, blue-armored veteran general roars, "Let me show you true power!" A dazzling golden radiance erupts around him, and he grips his weapon as he leaps violently into midair. Low-angle tracking shot, rule-of-thirds composition, the camera follows him as he rises, rapidly tilting up and pulling back.
quote: Let me show you true power!

text: Inside the same great hall, the red-eyed, black-armored general easily braces against the heavy blow and taunts coldly, "Is that all you've got? An ant is still an ant in the end." Immediately, his weapon jolts, releasing a domineering purple energy wave that instantly sends the white-haired, blue-armored veteran general flying several meters before he crashes down hard. Over-the-shoulder close-up transitioning into a rapid retreating tracking shot, rule-of-thirds composition, the image trembling with the energy wave.
quote: Is that all you've got? An ant is still an ant in the end.

text: Above a sacrificial altar under a sky thick with dark clouds, an enormous black beast circles in the air. Elder Li Yun, with white hair and a long beard, wearing a blue-green Daoist robe, looks up and roars angrily: "Vile creature, how dare you!" The camera rapidly tilts up from a low angle with a half-orbit, showing the giant beast's oppressive presence.
quote: Vile creature, how dare you!

text: At one corner of the collapsed sacrificial altar, a huge rock crashes down. Young warrior Zhao Xuan, wearing leather armor, lunges out with all his strength, pushes his companion away, and shouts: "Run!" The camera uses a low-angle upward shot, tracking right in slow motion with his rescue lunge, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Run!

text: A fantastical mountain valley, a giant golden palm print flies out through the air. A white-robed elder hovers in midair and thrusts out his palm, shouting: "Take my palm strike!" The camera follows the palm print in a high-speed push forward, then rapidly zooms in to a close-up of the elder, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Take my palm strike!

text: Inside the red barrier, the elder dodges blades of energy, bringing his hands together to gather golden light. He calls out: "Show me what you've really got!" A low-angle orbiting pan shot, showing his energy-gathering movement and the surrounding light and shadow in 360 degrees.
quote: Show me what you've really got!

text: At the center of the barrier, the martial artist controls a magic formation on the ground to block the golden-light attack. His brow furrows slightly, and he gives a cold snort: "Is that all?" The camera movement rapidly pushes in from a wide shot to a facial close-up, shot at eye level, intensifying the sense of oppression.
quote: Is that all?

text: In the same stone arena at night, the shot cuts to an eye-level locked-off close-up, and in the center-point composition, a young female chef with long green hair, an elaborate updo, and pearl hair ornaments suddenly widens her eyes, raises her eyebrows, and parts her mouth slightly, her face full of shock and panic, as she cries out involuntarily: "Ah!"
quote: Ah!

text: Still in the arena illuminated by candlelight, in an eye-level locked-off shot and a close shot with symmetrical composition, a boy chef with short blue hair and a red chef's hat stands on one side, while a young female chef's assistant with long red hair and golden hair ornaments stands on the other side; both are startled at the same time by the sight before them, the young female chef's assistant covering her mouth with her right hand, the boy chef opening his mouth wide and rounding his eyes, as they let out a cry in unison: "Ah!"
quote: Ah!

text: In an alien desert scorched by the blazing sun, a foot in a heavy mech boot stomps violently into the sand. A female scavenger captain wearing wasteland battle armor and a mechanical breathing mask snaps her head around, her eyes terrified and urgent, and shouts, "There's something underground, spread out!" The shot begins with a close-up of the combat boot, then rapidly whips upward (Whip-pan) and pushes in to a facial close-up, with dynamic tracking and a diagonal composition.
quote: There's something underground, spread out!

text: In the snow smashed into a deep pit, the hunter Leizi grits his teeth and uses his full body weight to pin the firearm horizontally across the masked soldier's chest; with one violent hand strike, there is a "click" as he forcibly pushes the bolt open to eject the round, completely disarming him. The shot begins with an extreme close-up of both men's hands, veins bulging, gripping the gun tightly, immediately followed by a sharp rack focus (Rack Focus), rapidly shifting focus from the gun in the foreground to the hunter Leizi's face, covered in ice and snow, his eyes fierce and resolute; the image freezes on an eye-level close shot, with centered composition, pushing the lingering tension of the fight scene to its climax.
quote: click

text: A dim living room at night, the exhausted middle-aged man Jianguo enters the frame. The camera follows him, dollying in and panning left (dolly-and-pan shot), revealing the anxious middle-aged woman Xiufen and the young man Xiaoyu on the sofa. Xiufen asks, "Did they manage to save her?" Medium shot, rule-of-thirds composition, warm light.
quote: Did they manage to save her?

text: In the same dining room, a young adventurer with short brown hair and green eyes excitedly picks up a bottle of wine from the table, gripping the bottle with both hands as he prepares to pull out the cork; his expression is elated, while beside him, a young female knight with blond hair and blue eyes, wearing pink lace pajamas, watches him calmly. The young adventurer chuckles softly and gives the response, "Ha." The shot is a medium shot, eye-level locked-off shot, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Ha.

text: Still in the same dining room, the shot cuts to the young adventurer's subjective point of view; in a partial extreme close-up, only his hands are seen gripping the top of the wine bottle as he strains to pull out the cork, but he suddenly stops at the instant he applies force, while in the background the roasting crab shell dishes steam. The image uses a subjective point-of-view locked-off shot, with a centered composition, as he judges in a wary low voice: "This is also a trap."
quote: This is also a trap.

text: Inside the dining room on a modern autumn night, the young adventurer is drenched in sweat and looks terrified, tightly protecting the wine bottle in his hands and refusing to let the blond-haired, blue-eyed young female knight beside him reach out and take it away; the two briefly struggle over the wine bottle, and the atmosphere suddenly becomes tense. After remembering the warning, the young adventurer hurriedly explains, saying with concern: "That dream-demon lady said you must not drink too much; if you sleep like the dead, you won't be able to dream." The shot is a medium shot, eye-level locked-off shot, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: That dream-demon lady said you must not drink too much; if you sleep like the dead, you won't be able to dream.

text: Inside the ring on the same freighter deck, the burly Big Bear briefly eases his attack, panting slightly, the corner of his mouth curling into a provocative smile as he stares straight ahead and says in a contemptuous tone: "You usually just toss a wok around in the kitchen; I didn't expect your fists to have a little power.". The instant the words leave his mouth, he explodes into motion, sending an extremely swift right hook straight toward the frame. The shot begins as an over-the-shoulder shot, filming Big Bear from Lightning's point of view; the instant Big Bear punches, the camera rapidly pushes in to a close-up of his face, with a strong handheld shake to heighten the realistic sense of pressure, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: You usually just toss a wok around in the kitchen; I didn't expect your fists to have a little power.

text: Inside the cockpit of a futuristic spaceship, in a high-tech space of blue and metallic gray, in front of the raised central command platform, a huge AI display screen is shown in an extreme close-up, with a blue energy core at the center of the screen constantly pulsing and morphing, and the words "AI Lisa" displayed at the top; static shot, centered composition. The AI on the screen calmly introduces: This is the parallel universe with the greatest density.
quote: AI Lisa

text: Inside the same futuristic spaceship cockpit, a young spaceship commander appears in close shot at the center of the frame, with a heavyset build, short orange hair standing straight up, and blue eyes, wearing a futuristic uniform in alternating green, purple, and white, seated in a chair with puffed cheeks, calmly looking straight ahead; beside his left shoulder floats a small pink furry alien creature with large ears and blue pointed horns, quietly keeping him company. Static shot, centered composition. The AI continues to explain: "Here, Earth is known as the Underworld."
quote: Here, Earth is known as the Underworld.

text: Still inside the spaceship cockpit, the AI display screen presents the target planet's environment by switching between long shots and close-ups: first, a dim, fog-filled, desolate landscape covered with sharp rocks, then switching to three-dimensional rotating models of a purple mechanical wolf and a golden mechanical lion, with the image continuously displayed in motion; static shot, symmetrical composition. The AI adds: "The climate is harsh, and it is inhabited by ferocious wolf and lion races."
quote: The climate is harsh, and it is inhabited by ferocious wolf and lion races.

text: The same AI display screen once again shows a long shot of the desolate planet, with jagged strange rocks, blue mist filling the frame, and dark, sharp rocks covering the ground, the image slowly panning horizontally to further present the planet's dim, ugly environment, completely unsuitable for sightseeing and taking photos; static shot, horizontal composition. The AI concludes: "Jagged strange rocks everywhere, unsuitable for sightseeing."
quote: Jagged strange rocks everywhere, unsuitable for sightseeing.

text: Inside the violently shaking mech cockpit, red warning lights flash wildly, and sparks and circuit debris keep falling from the ceiling. The chief pilot Ajie, wearing a silver-blue high-tech helmet and a heavy armored combat suit, is gripping the control sticks tightly, his body shaking violently from the tremendous inertia; anxious, he strains to turn his head toward the right and shouts at the top of his lungs: "The system is overloaded! Push all engine power to me!" The image opens with a handheld close-range close-up, focusing on Ajie's tense, sweat-covered face, then uses a tilted Dutch Angle together with an extremely fast Whip Pan to sweep toward the unresponsive co-pilot seat on the right, with a rule-of-thirds composition, creating an overwhelming sense of extreme chaos and imminent danger.
quote: The system is overloaded! Push all engine power to me!
intensity_words: at the top of his lungs
intensity_only_words: at the top of his lungs

text: In modern-day daytime, clear sunlight streams into a traditional Japanese kendo dojo, where wooden floors and wooden walls, along with washi sliding windows, form a spacious and quiet space, with a group of students kneeling in the back. The image is a medium shot, fixed camera, scattered composition, as a young female dojo member with long black hair and blue eyes stands at the front, nervously staring ahead together with the other students, her face pale, sweat sliding down her cheeks. She forces herself to withstand the pressure and, with a look of refusing to admit defeat, says: "I'll take all of you on at once.".
quote: I'll take all of you on at once.

text: Inside the same dojo, close shot, fixed camera, center-point composition. A smug young swordsman attendant with short brown hair and brown eyes stands in the center of the frame holding a bundle, first closing his eyes and nodding, then opening his eyes to reveal a smug smile, turning sideways to the left toward his master and suggesting: "Right, why not burn the signboard right out on the street? That would be more conspicuous……".
quote: Right, why not burn the signboard right out on the street? That would be more conspicuous……

text: In the same dojo, medium shot, fixed camera, diagonal composition. A frail young dojo member with upturned short black hair and red eyes suddenly rushes forward, grabs the brown-haired boy by the collar in one motion, forcibly stopping the other person's movement, his expression angry and impulsive, sternly shouting to stop him: "Stop being so insolent.".
quote: Stop being so insolent.

text: Inside the same traditional dojo, close shot, over-the-shoulder shot, over-the-shoulder shot composition. The camera looks from behind the black-haired boy's shoulder toward the brown-haired boy whose collar has been grabbed; the brown-haired boy lowers his head and looks down at him, the smugness on his face instantly disappearing and turning into gloom and anger, warning: "Let go of me, and mind your own business!".
quote: Let go of me, and mind your own business!

text: In a modern indoor animal enclosure at night, within the dim, spacious space, the rough stone walls and sandy ground appear quiet and lonely under warm yellow light, and a giraffe can still be seen in the center. In a chest-up close shot, a dark-skinned girl with a fluffy afro and a yellow headband lowers her head and carefully takes a necklace out from inside her collar, with a gold ring hanging from the necklace; her expression is calm yet tinged with sadness, and she says softly, "This is it.". The image uses an eye-level locked-off shot with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: This is it.

text: In the same animal enclosure at night, a young man with white skin, dark curly hair, and a green patterned jacket appears in a chest-up close shot within a low-angle locked-off shot, his expression focused and concerned; he stops what he is doing, looks up at the ring in the girl's hand, and asks earnestly, "This is what your parents left you?". The image maintains a rule-of-thirds composition, with a quiet atmosphere tinged with inquiry.
quote: This is what your parents left you?

text: In the same animal enclosure at night, the shot cuts to the girl in a chest-up close shot; under a high-angle locked-off shot, she gently strokes the giraffe beside her while, with a downcast expression, guessing that the letter on the ring may represent some name, then says dejectedly, "Or it may mean nothing at all.". The image uses a rule-of-thirds composition, with an atmosphere that is quiet, dejected, and slightly suspenseful.
quote: Or it may mean nothing at all.

text: On the boat in the night, the camera moves closer to a close shot, as the young scholar-knight in white-trimmed Hanfu leans in beside the young noble knight-errant's shoulder, rests a hand on his shoulder, and continues speaking with radiant excitement: "Painter Lu's paintings, General Lin's sword—two peerless wonders under heaven." He then takes one step back, spreads his arms, his expression extremely excited; the young noble knight-errant still watches him calmly. The image uses an eye-level fixed shot with a diagonal composition.
quote: Painter Lu's paintings, General Lin's sword—two peerless wonders under heaven.

text: In the center of the same wooden boat, the camera switches to a low-angle fixed shot, a medium wide shot with a central-point composition; the young scholar-knight in white-trimmed Hanfu stands in the middle of the boat, spreads his arms, tilts his head upward, his face full of excitement and satisfaction, while the surrounding young noble knight-errant, the gentle woman, and the other passengers all look at him; filled with heroic emotion, he sighs: "To be able to see them in a single night!"
quote: To be able to see them in a single night!

text: In a stifling modern bedroom in daytime, the camera frames a pair of pink rabbit slippers in a partial extreme close-up, with the slippers' round eyes and pink outline clearly visible, forming a stark contrast with the low, somber dialogue in the background; the frame remains fixed and unmoving, with a center-point composition. A middle-aged woman is wearing a dark red T-shirt and dark plaid pants, her emotions both sorrowful and angry, and she says coldly, "Yes, I want to make them pay."
quote: Yes, I want to make them pay.

text: In the same dim bedroom, the camera cuts back to a close shot of the middle-aged woman. Her head is lowered, her eyes look downward, and pain still lingers on her face, but her expression gradually becomes resolute; locked-off shot, center-point composition. As if talking to herself, she presses and confirms, "Make them pay? The people who hurt me? Yes, they must pay."
quote: Make them pay? The people who hurt me? Yes, they must pay.

text: Still in the old bedroom, the camera returns to a partial extreme close-up of the pink rabbit slippers. The plastic eyeballs look hollow, and the locked-off camera does not move, with a center-point composition; in the background, the middle-aged woman adds in a low voice with a note of warning, "Then those people... had better be careful, right?"
quote: Then those people... had better be careful, right?

text: In the same bedroom, the middle-aged woman appears in a close shot, locked-off shot, center-point composition; she slowly raises her head, the pain on her face replaced by calm and resolve, a cold smile appearing at the corner of her mouth as she responds calmly, "Exactly."
quote: Exactly.

text: In a dim, flooded elevator shaft, the water reaches waist height. The curly-haired young man Ajie wears a dark T-shirt, struggling in the water and shouting toward the elevator doors: "Is anyone there?!" The shot begins from a high overhead view, spiraling down to chest height, emphasizing the sense of oppression. Diagonal composition.
quote: Is anyone there?!

text: In a modern retro restaurant at night, warm-colored light falls on a dining table covered with documents. David, a curly-haired man in a dark blue shirt, sits on the left, and John, a short-haired man in a plaid shirt, sits on the right. John looks at the document in his hand, raises his head, and says to David, "The assistant said he cleared out the office after work on Friday." The frame slowly pushes forward from a wide shot to a two-person medium shot, eye-level shot, diagonal composition.
quote: The assistant said he cleared out the office after work on Friday.

text: In the same restaurant, a close-range close-up of David. His brow is slightly furrowed, his body leans slightly forward, and he asks back with a serious expression, "You had just checked the accounts on Thursday, and he transferred the assets in less than 48 hours?" The frame uses an over-the-shoulder shot, focusing on David over John's shoulder, then the camera slowly pans left, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: You had just checked the accounts on Thursday, and he transferred the assets in less than 48 hours?

text: Still in the restaurant at night, John emotionally rises from his seat, gesturing with both hands in front of his chest as he says, "Compare the timelines of the accounts on both sides, David." The frame is shot in a low-angle medium shot; as the character stands up, the camera tilts upward in sync and slowly pulls back, center-point composition.
quote: Compare the timelines of the accounts on both sides, David.

text: Inside the restaurant, the standing John looks at David and continues reasoning, "Eight months ago, he was fired for violations, and after that, those anonymous tip-off letters started being sent out." David raises his head and listens quietly. The shot uses an arcing trajectory, moving slowly and smoothly around the dining table from John's side to David's side profile, shifting from medium shot to close shot, dynamic composition.
quote: Eight months ago, he was fired for violations, and after that, those anonymous tip-off letters started being sent out.

text: Inside the same dim villain's lair, after the cage door slams shut, the black-and-white penguin agent captain and his companions are trapped inside the metal cage, huddling in the corner in panic; then he turns around, his expression quickly shifting from panic to determination, and reassures his companions: "Stay calm, don't panic." The shot is a fixed shot, medium shot, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Stay calm, don't panic.

text: Still inside the villain's lair shrouded in night, the camera looks outward from inside the cage, as the black-and-white penguin agent captain paces back and forth inside the cage, waving his flippers, passionately delivering a speech to the prisoners in the other cages in the distance, encouraging everyone by saying: "Victory belongs to us; be full of love, not hatred." The image is a wide shot, fixed shot, with depth-of-field composition.
quote: Victory belongs to us; be full of love, not hatred.

text: In the same eerie space, the camera slowly pans left, and the black-and-white penguin agent captain continues his impassioned speech inside the cage, waving his flippers, his expression determined and passionate; after the camera moves, the strong-built, sly-eyed red octopus villain appears on the right side of the frame, crossing his tentacles and staring disdainfully at the penguin in the cage. The penguin continues loudly: "Pursue your dreams, love yourself, care for others." The image is a medium shot, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Pursue your dreams, love yourself, care for others.

text: In an antique-style interior, medium shot, eye-level, locked-off camera. A middle-aged woman with her hair pinned up holds a wooden box, turns to the bald young man beside her, and instructs him: "It's raining. Hurry and get an umbrella." The bald young man turns around upon hearing this and goes to fetch the oil-paper umbrella standing in the corner.
quote: It's raining. Hurry and get an umbrella.

text: On a night street in an old town under pouring rain, wide shot, eye-level tracking shot. The bald young man and his male companion hurry through the rain under umbrellas. The male companion complains that the rain is too heavy, points at the umbrella, and says helplessly: "It's leaking. Get another one." Then he turns and runs off.
quote: It's leaking. Get another one.

text: In the office area of the same ape shelter, a middle-aged administrator stands up from behind the desk, holding a clipboard and pen, and walks toward the camera, his expression stern and cold. As he walks, he begins to say: "In my experience..." and prepares to continue dealing with the matter before him. The image is a wide shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, with a centered composition.
quote: In my experience...

text: Inside the oppressive shelter, a young white scientist stands between the chimpanzee and the administrator, looking conflicted as he speaks with the administrator, hesitating and not immediately taking the clipboard being handed to him; he looks at the chimpanzee, his tone soothing and hesitant, as if saying: "The longer the goodbye, the harder it gets. Can I sign later?" while the chimpanzee behind him watches all of this uneasily. The shot uses a three-person medium shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, with a triangular composition.
quote: The longer the goodbye, the harder it gets. Can I sign later?

text: From the chimpanzee's point of view, looking toward the other side of the glass, the young white scientist appears in a close shot, with an over-the-shoulder shot filmed from behind the chimpanzee; his brows are tightly furrowed, his expression serious and sad, and he looks through the glass at the chimpanzee, saying in a low voice: "You'll miss him, but he may not miss you." The image uses a rule-of-thirds composition, with a locked-off shot.
quote: You'll miss him, but he may not miss you.

text: A modern baseball practice field on a sunny summer day opens as an empty shot, the yellow-dirt field surrounded by a green wire-mesh fence, with dense woods and a residential building in the distance, the blue sky clear; the shot is filmed through the silhouettes of foreground leaves, the leaves swaying slightly, creating a quiet sense of establishing the environment. There are no people in the frame, and only the offscreen voice of a red-brown short-haired boy wearing a purple athletic tank top can be heard saying apologetically: "Sorry, I'm really sorry."; long shot, locked-off camera, eye level, frame composition.
quote: Sorry, I'm really sorry.

text: In the same baseball field, a black-haired boy wearing a gray short-sleeved T-shirt stands in the center of a medium shot, wearing a black stud earring, his expression calm and direct; he catches an incoming baseball, pauses briefly, then turns sideways into a standard pitching stance and throws the ball hard, the movement fluid and powerful. As he pitches, he says with a hint of resignation: "Who goes to a night game on a first date?"; the shot is a medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, center-point composition.
quote: Who goes to a night game on a first date?

text: Still on the brightly sunlit baseball field, a short-haired girl wearing a white polo shirt stands in the center of a medium shot, holding a baseball glove, her brows slightly furrowed, her expression displeased; she seems to be arguing with someone offscreen, then turns sideways and throws the baseball hard, her movement carrying a touch of petulance. She says unhappily: "We agreed the three of us would go together, and I was really looking forward to it."; the shot is a medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, center-point composition.
quote: We agreed the three of us would go together, and I was really looking forward to it.

text: In the same baseball practice field, a red-brown short-haired boy wearing a purple athletic tank top appears in the center of the frame in a medium shot, wearing a blue wristband, his smile bright and a little frivolous; he easily catches the incoming baseball, weighs it in his glove, then turns sideways and throws it, his movement casual and smug, while smiling and explaining: "Sorry, Xiao Li also said watching a night game was fine."; the shot is a medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, center-point composition.
quote: Sorry, Xiao Li also said watching a night game was fine.

text: On the deck of the same dilapidated airship, shot from a slightly higher angle looking down, the middle-aged captain leans beside the railing, while the young man stands opposite holding the cylindrical object, and the two continue their calm conversation; the captain, in a gentle tone, wishes him a smooth journey home, and adds "whatever that may be," with a canvas canopy and dilapidated railing visible in the background. The image remains a medium shot, high-angle static shot, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: whatever that may be,

text: Inside the same car, a young Caucasian agent is wearing a brown jacket and dark pants, with brown curly hair, a gaunt face, and a tense, pained expression; he grips the blue electronic device with both hands, anxiously operating it over and over while shouting to the left: "Stop! Stop!" The frame is a close shot, fixed shot, depth-of-field composition.
quote: Stop! Stop!

text: Still in the semi-open hall, a middle-aged police officer wearing a shirt, tie, and bulletproof vest, with gold-rimmed glasses, stands on the left side of the frame, with a squad of police officers who have rushed over following behind him; he calmly stares at the young criminal ahead and shouts the order: "Stop!" The shot uses a medium wide shot, with an eye-level locked-off shot and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Stop!

text: In the same location, the young criminal wearing sunglasses continues holding up the detonator, a smug expression on his face, and explains to the police officers opposite him: "This is a pressure detonator; as soon as I let go, the bomb will explode." The shot is a medium shot, with an eye-level locked-off shot and a center-point composition, the atmosphere tense and dangerous.
quote: This is a pressure detonator; as soon as I let go, the bomb will explode.

text: Under the red and blue firelight in the altar hall, in a chest-up close shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a centered composition, a gaunt-faced, frenzied member of the mysterious organization with gold teeth bared faces the camera directly, flailing his arms and legs, his expression excited and smug, twisting his face as he laughs loudly and says: "Of course there is a conspiracy! The Central Plains are prosperous and stable, the beautiful women are especially beautiful, and the handsome men are especially handsome."; in the eerie light, he appears especially neurotic, and the atmosphere is manic and unsettling.
quote: Of course there is a conspiracy! The Central Plains are prosperous and stable, the beautiful women are especially beautiful, and the handsome men are especially handsome.

text: In the same altar hall, the organization leader, with long hair draped over his shoulders and wearing a tall hat, appears at the center of the frame as the shot pushes in from a chest-up close shot to a shoulder-up close-up, with a slow eye-level push-in and a centered composition; his expression is grave, his eyes fierce, and standing before the flames, he says each word deliberately: "I truly hope to see the banner of our Golden Mountain Alliance flying over the lands of the Central Plains."; as the camera slowly pushes in, he clenches his teeth, his facial muscles taut, and his sense of ambition and sinister cunning grows ever stronger.
quote: I truly hope to see the banner of our Golden Mountain Alliance flying over the lands of the Central Plains.

text: In the same awards ceremony venue, a young female artist is wearing a blue reflective suit, a blue shirt, and a tie, with short black hair and black-rimmed glasses, her expression cheerful and excited; from her seat, she first shakes hands with the young man beside her, who is wearing sunglasses and a black leather jacket, then smiles and invites him to go onstage with her, saying: "Thank you. Congratulations, congratulations on winning the award. Ah Hua, let's go together."; while the young man smiles and shakes his head to decline. Then the young female artist gets up and prepares to go onstage, and the young man also wipes his face with his hand. The image is a medium shot of the two of them, a fixed eye-level shot, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Thank you. Congratulations, congratulations on winning the award. Ah Hua, let's go together.

text: In the same sutra library, the female assassin "Night Owl" has a razor-sharp gaze, instantly drawing two cold-gleaming short blades from behind her back with both hands, then suddenly swinging her left arm and throwing a refined-steel dart. The shot uses an extremely fast push-in (Crash Zoom), tightly following the dart's flight path, finally freezing in an extreme macro close-up at the instant the dart drives deep into a mahogany pillar, as wood splinters burst apart and fly in all directions, conveying a fierce sense of speed.
quote: Night Owl

text: In a dim, abandoned wooden warehouse, Marcus, a bald Black expert in a gray suit, is carefully examining the black dot with a custom magnifying glass. The image uses a low-angle circular dolly shot (Circular Dolly), shot against backlight, with interlaced light and shadow conveying a sense of suspense. He puts down the magnifying glass and says in a low voice in English: "This is a microdot photograph, but there's nothing on it. That's highly unusual."
quote: This is a microdot photograph, but there's nothing on it. That's highly unusual.

text: In the same police station office, the young Black police officer and the middle-aged Asian police officer are still handcuffed, their bodies twisting from discomfort, and the shot changes to an eye-level shaky handheld shot; the young Black police officer shouts anxiously: "Get us down, now!", and the posture of the two men being cuffed forms a diagonal composition.
quote: Get us down, now!

text: In the office, an elderly white police officer wears a gray suit, has a small mustache, and looks composed with a hint of sarcasm, standing in the center of the frame with both hands in his trouser pockets. Under an eye-level static shot, he calmly looks at the two of them, then raises his right hand and asks sternly: "Listen, what are you doing in Paris?" The shot is a close shot with center-point composition.
quote: Listen, what are you doing in Paris?

text: In the same alien cave, the shot cuts to a close-up of the young white astronaut's face. Through his spacesuit helmet, he looks toward the front left, focused, speaking quietly over the communications device: "Ready to move, tether secured."; The frame is an eye-level locked-off shot, with centered composition.
quote: Ready to move, tether secured.

text: Still inside the dark alien cave, the young Black astronaut wears a spacesuit helmet, his expression calm and professional, his eyes looking upward toward the front as he replies calmly over the communications device: "Okay, I hear you."; The shot is a facial close-up, an eye-level locked-off shot, with centered composition.
quote: Okay, I hear you.

text: Inside the same futuristic cave, the young white astronaut appears in a medium shot from the waist up, wearing his spacesuit, raising his arm and slowly moving forward as if preparing to enter an even narrower passage; while checking his status, he says over comms: "Orey, suit pressure 35."; The frame uses an eye-level locked-off shot, with centered composition.
quote: Orey, suit pressure 35.

text: In the same family-run barbershop, the middle-aged man wearing round glasses appears in a close shot at the center of the frame, eye-level locked-off shot, centered composition; as he chews the cake, he looks toward his wife opposite him with a satisfied yet proud expression and takes the initiative to ask her, "It's good, right?"
quote: It's good, right?

text: In the same interior space, the middle-aged man wearing round glasses appears again in a close shot, eye-level locked-off camera, centered composition; after hearing his wife's complaint, his expression turns serious, and with a touch of stubbornness he retorts, "But they just had cookies yesterday," defending his decision to buy cake.
quote: But they just had cookies yesterday,

text: Inside the same parking garage, the teenage student continues riding the unicycle, and an eye-level locked-off shot captures his body leaning forward as he looks ahead in surprise, as if he has suddenly encountered an unexpected situation; he cannot help letting out a "Whoa!", his tone carrying panic and surprise. The frame is a medium shot with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Whoa!

text: At a nighttime cremation site, firelight casts its glow. The blond boy Allen looks up and anxiously asks about the future. The cloaked man Jack lowers his head to gaze at him and solemnly promises: "The Council of Elders has agreed to let me train you. You will become a warrior." The frame uses an over-the-shoulder close-up, and the camera slowly pushes in, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: The Council of Elders has agreed to let me train you. You will become a warrior.

text: Inside a room in an ancient Japanese residence, the light is soft. A woman wearing a red-orange traditional kimono, her long hair loose over her shoulders, lowers her head slightly, her expression sorrowful and solemn, and asks softly, "Is that everything? You're not hiding anything else from me, are you?" The shot is a close shot, with a slow push-in and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Is that everything? You're not hiding anything else from me, are you?

text: Inside the same room in the residence, a woman wearing a purple-red kimono has slightly reddened eyes, raises her head a little, and her gaze reveals awe and restraint as she gives a brief answer, "Yes." The shot is a facial close-up, filmed from a low angle looking up, with a slight camera pan.
quote: Yes.

text: Also in the room in the residence, the red-orange traditional kimono woman's gaze becomes resolute, and she commands in a grave tone, "Please keep this matter buried deep in your heart, until the day you die." The shot is a close shot from the chest up, a static shot with a slight high angle, with the character centered.
quote: Please keep this matter buried deep in your heart, until the day you die.

text: Still in the room in the residence, the woman in the purple-red kimono has a heavy expression, a trace of obedience showing in her eyes, and nods slightly in response, "All right." The shot is a facial close-up, a static eye-level shot, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: All right.

text: Back on the ground, Chen gives up resisting, gasping rapidly as he shouts: "Stop fighting! I'll talk, someone can testify for me!" The image uses a ground-level extreme close-up, shallow depth of field, with a fixed shot slowly pushing in and freezing on his anxious brows and eyes.
quote: Stop fighting! I'll talk, someone can testify for me!

text: In a contemporary Japanese sushi restaurant during the daytime in summer, the wooden counter, dining tables, menus on the wall, sake bottles on the shelves, and plates are all clearly visible, the lighting is bright, and the atmosphere in the restaurant is lively. In a medium, eye-level locked-off shot with a horizontal composition, two male customers sit at a dining table eating sushi; the middle-aged male customer in a white shirt and tie is smiling, holding up a beer glass, and speaking proudly toward someone off-screen: "The owner really did find a good chef, no doubt about it."; the other customer is about to use his chopsticks to pick up a piece of sushi.
quote: The owner really did find a good chef, no doubt about it.

text: Behind the counter in the same sushi restaurant, in a medium, eye-level locked-off shot with a deep-focus composition, several chefs stand together; in the foreground, a young sushi chef wearing a white headscarf and a Japanese chef's uniform smiles and begins to speak, saying in a tone of approval: "Ah, it's really all thanks to his help.", the chefs behind him also smile, while the people in the distance look more serious.
quote: Ah, it's really all thanks to his help.

text: Inside the same sushi restaurant, in a close-up, eye-level locked-off shot with a center-point composition, only a half-finished glass on the table is seen sitting there quietly, with a small amount of liquid still left in it, and a joking question comes from off-screen: "What do you think, boss?"
quote: What do you think, boss?

text: Still in the sushi restaurant, in a medium, eye-level locked-off shot with a rule-of-thirds composition, a young apprentice employee in a Japanese chef's uniform bends down from the right side of the frame and reaches out to take the glass on the table, but his movement suddenly stops because he hears the joke, and surprise appears on his face; he then somewhat rashly chimes in: "How about handing this restaurant over to him?"
quote: How about handing this restaurant over to him?

text: Still in the mine tunnel, their coworker "Daqiang" suddenly rushes in from off-screen, wraps his arms tightly around the enraged Ah Feng from behind, and desperately drags him backward; Ah Feng struggles violently, trying to break free and continue attacking. The image uses a medium-shot orbit camera movement (Arc Shot), dynamically capturing the tense and chaotic confrontation among the three men.
quote: Daqiang

text: Also inside the mine, Daqiang tightly locks Ah Feng's arms and shouts anxiously: "Stop fighting! Your son is missing!" Ah Feng instantly freezes, stops struggling, and his eyes shift from anger to extreme shock and panic. The camera quickly pushes in (Push-in) to a close-up of Ah Feng's face, at eye level, with the background deeply blurred.
quote: Stop fighting! Your son is missing!

text: In a close shot on the nighttime beach, the camera shoots from the side and remains static. The white-haired mushi master, carrying the wooden box on his back and holding a small stick in his mouth, turns his face sideways with a serious expression and explains, "If it isn't a 'mushi-calling' one, it can't be used to open caves; very few can be used." The image uses rule-of-thirds composition to emphasize his calm, restrained tone.
quote: If it isn't a 'mushi-calling' one, it can't be used to open caves; very few can be used.

text: Beside a bench at the edge of the same tennis court, a teenage tennis player with short red hair sits dejectedly, a white towel draped over his head, both hands clenched into fists. An eye-level upward tilt shot slowly rises from his fists to his face, shadows falling across his face and revealing his repressed yet unyielding expression; beside him stands an elderly coach with short gray-white hair and a kind face. With rule-of-thirds composition, the boy apologizes in a low voice, saying: "I'm sorry, I lost."
quote: I'm sorry, I lost.

text: Still on the same tennis court, the elderly coach with short gray-white hair appears in a shoulders-up close-up, in a locked-off side shot. With a kind, encouraging smile on his face, he gently says to the boy with his eyes closed: "Don't worry about it. Your ability is no worse than anyone else's. Now it's up to you."; the image maintains rule-of-thirds composition, and the atmosphere is warm and resolute.
quote: Don't worry about it. Your ability is no worse than anyone else's. Now it's up to you.

text: In the same venue, the teenage tennis player with short red hair appears in a shoulders-up close-up, in a locked-off side shot. He lifts his face from beneath the towel covering his head, his eyes burning with unyielding fighting spirit, and looks firmly ahead as he says: "Coach, in order to win, I'm going to change my style and start from scratch!"; the shot maintains rule-of-thirds composition, and the emotion shifts from dejection to determination.
quote: Coach, in order to win, I'm going to change my style and start from scratch!

text: In the same classroom, an eye-level locked-off shot, close-up, center-point composition; against a white background, a diagram showing the process of cell mitosis is displayed, with multiple boxes showing cell states and arrows forming a cycle. The image is static and clear like a classroom lecture slide, and the voiceover asks: "What is the proliferation in which a cell divides into two called?", guiding the audience to think about the answer.
quote: What is the proliferation in which a cell divides into two called?

text: On the riverbank at dusk beneath the silhouette of a hillside, in a low-angle locked-off long shot, after running uphill, the young boxer is completely exhausted, bending over with both hands on his knees, panting so hard he can barely straighten up; the older coach stands beside the motorcycle nearby, watching him calmly, and says: "You've entered the most grueling phase now." The frame uses a rule-of-thirds composition, emphasizing the weary confrontation between the hillside and the figures.
quote: You've entered the most grueling phase now.

text: In a close shot at the same riverside location at dusk, the young boxer appears at the center of the frame in an eye-level locked-off shot, bent over, his side profile facing the camera, gasping heavily, his chest heaving violently with each breath, his expression pained yet carrying a stubborn refusal to give in; between breaths, he asks back: "Has my time gotten worse?" The shot maintains a center-point composition, reinforcing his stubbornness amid extreme exhaustion.
quote: Has my time gotten worse?

text: In a modern-era rural farmhouse kitchen on a winter night, the dim interior is full of the lived-in smell of cooking smoke, flatbread is being griddled on a round stove, steam hangs in the air, strings of garlic and other odds and ends hang on the wall, and the environment is simple and plain. A middle-aged villager with a dark complexion and stubble walks into the room clutching his injured nose, his expression pained and somewhat agitated; the middle-aged housewife who was busy working and the teenage student sitting off to the side immediately look up at him, then hurriedly turn to meet him. Clutching his nose, the middle-aged villager says in pain: "My nose is stinging like crazy, and it's bleeding."; the shot is a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: My nose is stinging like crazy, and it's bleeding.

text: In the same dim rural farmhouse kitchen, the middle-aged housewife quickly walks over to the middle-aged villager, helps him sit down on a nearby stool with concern, her movements efficient and anxious. The middle-aged villager is still clutching his nose, his expression uncomfortable; while soothing him, the middle-aged housewife urges him to sit properly and says worriedly: "What happened? Come on, sit down quickly."; the shot uses a medium shot, a handheld tracking shot, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: What happened? Come on, sit down quickly.

text: In the smoke-filled rural farmhouse kitchen, the middle-aged villager has already sat down and is tilting his head back, while the middle-aged housewife focuses on holding a small wad of hemostatic material and carefully stuffs it into his nostril, trying to help stop the bleeding. The middle-aged villager complains while enduring the pain, and the middle-aged housewife lowers her head and concentrates on treating him. He complains: "That stubborn donkey kicked me just now."; the shot is a medium close-up, an eye-level locked-off shot, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: That stubborn donkey kicked me just now.

text: Inside the same dim rural farmhouse kitchen, the smoke is a little thicker, and the middle-aged housewife bends down to continue treating the nose of the middle-aged villager, who is tilting his head back, her movements meticulous and focused. While pressing the hemostatic material in place, she calmly says: "Let it settle down for a bit."; the image uses a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, with diagonal composition.
quote: Let it settle down for a bit.

text: Inside the cockpit of a sci-fi spaceship, dim blue lights flicker. The shot uses a slow push-in wide shot and pans left. A one-eyed, white-haired female commander and an orange-haired boy stand in front of the control console. Jack leans back, looking panicked, while Lucy supports him with one hand and says with a cold expression: "Looks like you'll have to face only a fifty-fifty chance of survival.". Rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Looks like you'll have to face only a fifty-fifty chance of survival.

text: In the same cockpit, a close-up of Lucy's face. The shot uses a subtle orbiting movement (Orbit) to add a sense of dynamism. With a calm expression and a slightly teasing tone, she says softly: "Now you believe I wasn't lying to you, right?". Center-focus composition, shallow depth of field.
quote: Now you believe I wasn't lying to you, right?

text: In the great hall of an ancient palace, an overhead locked-off shot captures a finely carved ancient dagger and its sheath lying quietly on the rough black floor. In the dim light, the character for "war" is faintly visible at the bottom of the frame. The overall mood is solemn, austere, and oppressive; close-up, diagonal composition.
quote: war

text: Inside the great hall, a burly middle-aged general wearing ancient commander's armor appears frontally in a close shot, with an eye-level locked-off shot and center-point composition. His eyes are wide with anger, and he opens his mouth to shout furiously: "Those despicable Yang father and sons!" Then he closes his mouth, his gaze still resolute and forceful.
quote: Those despicable Yang father and sons!

text: Still inside the oppressive and solemn ancient palace hall, an over-the-shoulder locked-off shot films from behind the young lord. The middle-aged general, with two subordinates, strides quickly over from the distance and stands in the center of the frame, looking at the lord with agitation as he earnestly requests troops: "My lord! Give me thirty thousand troops, and let me retake Jingzhou." The frame uses a medium shot and depth-of-field composition, with a tense and determined atmosphere.
quote: My lord! Give me thirty thousand troops, and let me retake Jingzhou.

text: Deep within the dust-filled chaos of the troops, a swordsman in a white robe and a cloak rides his horse into a leap. His movements are agile, and he holds a long sword in each hand, crossing them in midair to slash and precisely deflect the weapons thrusting toward him from all around. After landing, he suddenly pulls the reins tight, the warhorse's front hooves rearing high, and he turns back with an anxious expression, shouting toward the rear right: "Second Brother, Third Brother, we are outnumbered, retreat now!" The shot first uses a low-angle medium shot to show his mounted movement, then rapidly pushes in to a close-up from the chest up, with a centered composition.
quote: Second Brother, Third Brother, we are outnumbered, retreat now!

text: In the enemy's main formation on high ground, an old man wearing a gray-and-yellow robe, with a thick long beard, stands before battle flags fluttering in the wind. He stares fixedly at the retreating figures below, his brow relaxing, the corners of his mouth lifting to reveal a fanatical and smug smile, then he suddenly leans forward and roars: "Don't let them get away, all forces, charge!" The image uses an eye-level close-up in a close shot scale, the camera slowly pushing forward, precisely capturing his ambition-filled facial expression, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Don't let them get away, all forces, charge!

text: In front of the martial arts school gate, Ajie lies beside a stone roller, his face filled with shock and unwillingness. Aqiang steps forward, points the broadsword straight at his face, and shouts sternly: "Your staff technique still isn't quite there!" The frame is a high-angle over-the-shoulder shot, fixed camera, rule-of-thirds composition, with an extremely strong sense of visual oppression.
quote: Your staff technique still isn't quite there!

text: In a huge circular library/secret archive in modern daytime, the wooden floor and tabletop are illuminated by warm light, surrounded by bookshelves on all sides, with a solemn and mysterious atmosphere. A white-haired elderly scholar with glasses and a white beard stands leaning over the table, in a close shot, eye-level locked-off camera, center-point composition; he lowers his head in concentration, looking at the ancient parchment on the table, then reaches out and tears one of the sheets open, judging in a low voice: "It is evenly matched with the Black King.". The shot remains stable overall, highlighting his calm and learned expression.
quote: It is evenly matched with the Black King.

text: In the same library, a bald elderly scholar with round glasses and a white drooping mustache stands in front of the bookshelves, in a close shot, eye-level locked-off camera, rule-of-thirds composition; the corners of his mouth lift, carrying a faintly smug smile, as he looks toward the off-screen right foreground and says calmly yet firmly: "This is the only word spirit that can counter the Emperor.".
quote: This is the only word spirit that can counter the Emperor.

text: Still inside the warm and mysterious archive, a high-angle shot slowly moves upward, gradually shifting from a close-up to a medium shot, scattered composition; the white-haired old scholar's hands gently stroke the ancient parchments on the table, and as the camera moves upward, more parchments spread across the tabletop are gradually revealed, their surfaces densely covered with ancient writing. As he flips through them, he adds in explanation: "It cleansed the bloodline of the offspring, making them kneel no longer.", the image emphasizing the weight of the stacked documents and mysterious knowledge.
quote: It cleansed the bloodline of the offspring, making them kneel no longer.

text: Beneath the rock wall, Kyle grips the long staff tightly, burning golden streams of light spilling from his hand; he pants rapidly, then suddenly looks up toward the upper right, his pupils constricting slightly, and murmurs in shock: "So… it's you." The image cuts in from a medium close-up, uses a slow 180-degree orbit camera movement, and finally freezes on a facial close-up, with a centered composition.
quote: So… it's you.

text: In the great hall, where the residual energy has dissipated and smoke hangs in the air, the red-haired young woman Ahe, wearing a black leather vest, struggles to crawl up from the ground. She pats the dust from her body, looks at the unconscious monsters collapsed all over the floor and the altar that has returned to calm, lets out a long breath, and says to herself with a weary yet relieved expression: "It's finally over." The image is a close-up transitioning to a medium shot, using a low-angle, eye-level panning shot focused on her relieved facial expression, with a blurred wide shot of the palace in the background and a highly narrative composition.
quote: It's finally over.

text: In a sunlit town square on an autumn day in ancient times, golden fallen leaves dance in the wind, surrounded by antique-style buildings. Young Hero Li, a young knight-errant wearing a blue-purple fitted martial outfit and a high ponytail, has the corners of his mouth slightly raised and a confident look in his eyes. He draws a short blade from his waist and scoffs provocatively, "It's just a throwing knife, I can do that too!" As soon as he finishes speaking, he suddenly hurls the short blade forward. The image begins with an over-the-shoulder shot, then quickly pushes in (Crash Zoom), rapidly focusing on a close-up of Young Hero Li's confident, swaggering face, with rule-of-thirds composition and full of dynamism.
quote: It's just a throwing knife, I can do that too!

quote: This... originally, it was said that everyone would chip in to offer birthday congratulations?

text: In the same living room, in an eye-level fixed shot, a medium shot with symmetrical composition, a young girl with long brown hair, wearing a blue-and-white short-sleeved top and white pants, panics after seeing the cup tip over and opens her mouth wide; beside her, a young man with short gray-brown hair, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt over a black T-shirt, frowns and leans forward, scolding her, "Ah! What are you doing?", while reaching out to pick up a tissue and wipe the liquid spilled on the tabletop.

Diagonal composition.
