The frame uses a rule-of-thirds composition, with clear and soft daytime light.
quote: I don't know how.

text: On the canyon high ground after the explosion, Captain Lei, dressed in a dark gray tactical suit and wearing a resolute expression, suddenly rises out of the gunsmoke, raises a light machine gun, and shouts loudly, "Don't fall back, keep them pinned down!" The camera movement uses a complex dynamic orbit shot, rapidly rotating 180 degrees around Captain Lei while quickly pushing in from a wide shot to a close shot above the chest; the background is filled with constantly flickering firelight and stray bullets flying across, diagonal composition, highlighting the character's decisiveness in adversity.
quote: Don't fall back, keep them pinned down!

text: Inside the rugged trench of the canyon, facing the dense firepower below, Afei quickly makes a tactical response. The shot uses a low, ground-hugging tracking camera movement, closely following Afei's actions: first, he makes an agile forward roll to dodge a burst of sweeping fire, then slides down onto one knee, working the bolt to chamber a round and opening fire decisively with seamless fluidity. Here, a "bullet time" effect combining fast and slow speed is used, slowing down his composed movement at the instant he fires, then instantly returning to normal speed, creating an extremely powerful visual impact, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: bullet time

text: In a dim, smoke-filled abandoned factory, the special forces soldier "Falcon," dressed in camouflage tactical gear, advances with an assault rifle. A Steadicam follows, with an eye-level rule-of-thirds composition; he detects an unusual sound, suddenly turns around, raises his rifle, and stands alert.
quote: Falcon,

text: Inside the same factory, an enemy in black rushes out from the ruins. A fast push-in shifts from a wide shot to a medium shot; "Falcon" dives sideways to evade, drops to one knee, his gaze sharp.
quote: Falcon

text: The factory after the fight, a long shot shifts to an overhead pullback; the enemy has been subdued, and "Falcon" maintains an alert posture. A slow backward camera move, with cold-toned lighting accentuating the grim, lethal atmosphere.
quote: Falcon

text: In an old hutong in daytime, the young man Li Ming, wearing a uniform jacket, suddenly steps forward and violently locks his arm around the neck of Wang Qiang, a young man in a green hoodie, sternly warning him, "Stay away!" Wang Qiang struggles with all his strength and pushes Li Ming away with a backhanded palm strike. The image uses Steadicam orbit camera movement, tracking the two men's actions at a fast pace, with a centered composition.
quote: Stay away!

text: In another corner of the same warehouse, a steady middle-aged man wearing a baseball cap and a thick jacket has his back against a stack of tall wooden crates. Countless bullets strike the crates, sending wood chips flying everywhere like rain in the harsh light. The shot rapidly pushes in from the enemy's point of view, passing through layers of smoke, finally locking onto the middle-aged man in an angled medium shot; pinned down and unable to raise his head, amid the deafening gunfire, he shouts angrily and anxiously with all his strength toward the young woman: "Retreat now!"
quote: Retreat now!

text: In a modern university campus courtyard on a sunny spring day, a classical-style teaching building stands at the center of the frame, with a fountain spraying water in the foreground, lawns, trees, and stone benches surrounding it, tree branches slightly obscuring the building, the overall mood tranquil and full of an academic atmosphere; the subtitle "Friday" is overlaid on the image. Wide fixed shot, eye-level, centered composition.
quote: Friday

text: On a stone bench beside a lawn on the same campus, a young male student and a young female student sit side by side, with their backs to the camera; the young male student wears an off-white jacket and a blue shirt, lowers his head as he flips through a newspaper, his expression serious and focused; the young female student wears round-frame glasses, a beige trench coat, and a black turtleneck underneath, turns her head sideways toward him and says, in a worried tone, "The whole school is talking about what happened with Ah Jie now." Chest-up close shot, fixed shot, eye-level, centered composition.
quote: The whole school is talking about what happened with Ah Jie now.

text: Cut to a shoulder-up close-up of the young male student; he lowers his head and looks at the newspaper in his hands, his gaze focused and his expression heavy, as if responding to the other person, and says in a low voice: "I never thought he would suddenly drop out..." Shoulder-up close-up, fixed shot, slightly high angle, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: I never thought he would suddenly drop out...

text: Still in the tranquil campus courtyard, a chest-up close shot of the young female student; she wears round-frame glasses, her expression worried, her gaze directed toward the offscreen person on the right, her lips moving slightly as she continues to add: "Yeah, everyone thinks this happened too suddenly." Fixed shot, eye-level, centered composition.
quote: Yeah, everyone thinks this happened too suddenly.

text: Inside a lavish ancient boudoir at night, the room is brightly lit, with a wooden dressing table, screens, and lanterns creating a warm and intimate atmosphere. Two young women kneel side by side in front of the window, their backs to the camera as they look out at the night outside; beyond the window, the dreamlike cherry blossom tree scene from the previous shot is faintly visible. A melancholy woman in blue-green robes, with long hair, pink flowers, and golden hair ornaments, sits shoulder to shoulder with a mature woman whose black hair is pinned up and who wears ornate red-purple clothing, creating an intimate atmosphere. The richly dressed woman turns slightly, speaking with concern and a hint of teasing: "I haven't seen you for several days, and I was afraid some man had whisked my little sister away."; The shot is a medium shot, eye-level static shot, symmetrical composition.
quote: I haven't seen you for several days, and I was afraid some man had whisked my little sister away.

text: In the softly lit boudoir, the woman in blue-green robes sits in front of the dressing table, while the richly dressed woman stands behind her and carefully inserts the golden hairpin she just picked up into her hair. The petal-like tiny ornaments seem to drift gently down through the air. The woman in blue-green robes lifts her head slightly, revealing a shy smile, while the mature woman behind her also watches her with a smile, her eyes full of affection and concern. The woman in blue-green robes says softly: "Thank you, sister."; The shot is a medium shot, eye-level static shot, center-point composition.
quote: Thank you, sister.

text: Behind a nearby piece of cover, deputy team leader Zhang Qiang witnesses this scene, his expression shocked, tragic, and furious; the shot uses a rapid push-in close-up, accompanied by the flashing white glare of violent explosions in the background, quickly focusing on Zhang Qiang's reddened eyes and his mouth opened wide as he shouts, as he roars in a hoarse, furious voice: "Li Ming!—" The image is filled with extremely strong emotional tension.
quote: Li Ming!—

text: In a mountain region at dusk, beneath a purple-blue gradient sky, the sunset glow dyes the clouds pink, while steep rock faces and distant mountains form an open, magnificent background. A locked-off, front-facing shot, close-up above the shoulders, in a centered composition: a frail young adventurer with short light-blue hair, a single ahoge sticking up on top of his head, and a green cloak first looks at a stone number "7" in the air shatter and then reassemble; afterward, his cheeks flush, his eyes turn into circles, and his mouth opens wide, revealing an exaggerated expression of shock and dejection as he says with a hint of self-mockery, "About a 7, I guess."
quote: in the air shatter and then reassemble; afterward, his cheeks flush, his eyes turn into circles, and his mouth opens wide, revealing an exaggerated expression of shock and dejection as he says with a hint of self-mockery,

text: In the same mountain region at dusk, a locked-off side shot, medium shot, using a diagonal composition. The young adventurer leans backward, his expression pained, and pulls with all his strength on a large bow stuck in the mud; the bowstring is drawn extremely tight, the end of the bow is deeply embedded in the purple soil, and the surrounding mud deforms slightly; as he strains to pull the bow, he sighs enviously, "I really envy you two, A-Qiang and Jack."
quote: I really envy you two, A-Qiang and Jack.

text: In the same mountain region at dusk, a locked-off side shot, wide shot, rule-of-thirds composition. The young adventurer continues pulling hard on the bow, but the enormous elastic force suddenly sends him flying backward; he tumbles through the air toward the left side of the frame and finally slams heavily into the center of a huge circular stone target in the distance carved with intricate patterns; at the instant he flies out of control, he shouts in embarrassment, "I went to all that trouble to be the first to say, 'Please give me the most powerful equipment,' and then……"
quote: I went to all that trouble to be the first to say, 'Please give me the most powerful equipment,' and then……

text: On the same castle balcony, in a high-angle static shot, the young elven archer is already half-crouched on the left side of the balcony, while the boy traveler who has just landed crashes heavily from off-screen onto the ground on the right, awkwardly rolls forward once, and cries out, "Whoa! Whoa!", making the scene both tense and comical; the image uses a wide shot and a diagonal composition.
quote: Whoa! Whoa!

text: On the same balcony, in an eye-level static shot, the young elven archer stands on the left side of the frame and draws the bowstring, aiming sharply ahead; on the right, the boy traveler has just climbed to his feet, and when he sees her raise the bow, he immediately lifts both hands nervously, leans backward, and hurriedly shouts: "Whoa, careful! Don't shoot me."; the shot uses a medium shot and a symmetrical composition.
quote: Whoa, careful! Don't shoot me.

text: In a virtual training space, purple light crisscrosses. The beast-eared girl Yaxiang, wielding dual guns, stares ahead and murmurs her analysis: "Turning sideways will present a smaller target, and the ballistic path will also tighten." The white-haired girl Shirley, wielding a lightsaber, turns sideways to defend, smiling calmly. The camera quickly pushes in from a wide shot to a close-up of Yaxiang's face, with follow-focus panning and rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Turning sideways will present a smaller target, and the ballistic path will also tighten.

text: In the same space, Yaxiang opens fire fiercely, light bolts shooting through the air. Shirley's gaze sharpens, and she swings her sword to precisely knock the light bolts away, letting out a soft shout: "I've seen through it!" Yaxiang's face is filled with shock. The shot uses a high-speed tracking shot, traveling from the bullet's perspective to in front of Shirley, then abruptly whip-panning back to a close-up of Yaxiang's astonishment, with strong motion blur.
quote: I've seen through it!

text: In the dim stairwell of an old apartment building at night, the short-haired girl Xiao Li, wearing a blue-and-white school uniform, sprints downstairs in terror, glancing back from time to time. Behind her, the girl Xiao Wang, who is chasing her, shouts: "Xiao Li, stop right there!" The image uses a handheld tracking shot, moving quickly, transitioning from a medium shot to a close-up, with a dynamic tilted composition.
quote: Xiao Li, stop right there!

text: On the stone steps outside the old apartment building, Xiao Li flees along the steps into the distance, her figure gradually blurring. The pursuers' shouts come from offscreen: "What are you running for!" The shot transitions from a wide shot to an extreme long shot, panning right to follow the character, with a fixed camera position.
quote: What are you running for!

text: In the sky above the valley as night falls, a flare trails white smoke and slices through the night sky. Li Jian stares intently through the scope, his eyes shifting slightly, and counts down precisely in a low voice: "Thirty-six, thirty-seven, thirty-eight…". The shot first films the flare from a low angle, then uses a rapid whip pan (Whip Pan) to transition seamlessly to a close-up of Li Jian's eyes.
quote: Thirty-six, thirty-seven, thirty-eight…

text: In the noisy underground sand-and-dirt fighting arena, spectators crowd around the wooden railing. A middle-aged man in a blue denim shirt and an elderly man in a yellow printed shirt watch the match side by side. The elderly man in the yellow printed shirt turns his head to the middle-aged man in the blue denim shirt and says, "There are quite a few promising prospects in here." The image is a medium shot, with the camera slowly pushing forward and panning slightly to the right, using a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: There are quite a few promising prospects in here.

text: In an ancient-style bedroom with red gauze bed curtains, the lighting is sultry. The young Li Feng, wearing a headband and bare-chested, lies on a brocade quilt, smiling with his eyes closed and murmuring: "Little beauty, couldn't bear to part with your master?". Close shot, the camera slowly pulls back and rotates slightly, diagonal composition.
quote: Little beauty, couldn't bear to part with your master?

text: In the same bedroom, Li Feng suddenly opens his eyes, his expression shocked and panicked, and cries out: "My waist token was taken by the Thousand-Faced Fox?". Extreme close-up, frontal rapid push-in to the eyes, with a slight shake, centered composition.
quote: My waist token was taken by the Thousand-Faced Fox?

text: Inside the bedroom, Commander Wang, a female official with purple hair and golden armor, enters with guards, sneering mockingly: "A city patrol commandant actually helped a fugitive. Talk, how much were you paid?". The guards step forward and cuff Li Feng. Medium shot with a following pan, over-the-shoulder shot, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: A city patrol commandant actually helped a fugitive. Talk, how much were you paid?

text: Beside the bed, the cuffed Li Feng looks utterly embarrassed and evasive, stammering in defense: "My lord Chief Banner, there seems to be some misunderstanding.". Low-angle close shot, slight orbiting movement, golden spiral composition.
quote: My lord Chief Banner, there seems to be some misunderstanding.

text: The plaza outside a modern city office building, daytime. Agent Li Lei, wearing a suit and sunglasses, crouches by the roadside to provide cover. Female agent Han Mei, dressed in black, touches the communicator in her right ear, her gaze sharp, and reports in a low voice: "I'm watching them now." Beside her, agent Zhang Hua in a black T-shirt looks solemn and remains on alert. The frame is a medium shot, with the camera slowly panning right to track the action, and a shallow depth of field emphasizes the characters' facial expressions.
quote: I'm watching them now.

text: On the plaza ground, Zhang Hua drops to one knee and pins the target firmly to the ground, sternly barking the order: "Don't move!" Han Mei quickly crouches beside him to help control the situation. The frame begins with a close-up of the face, then slowly tilts down with the action to the restrained person on the ground, finally becoming an eye-level locked-off shot with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Don't move!

text: Inside a car driving during the day, middle-aged man Bob (wearing a dark red shirt) suddenly lunges out from the back seat, trying to grab the steering wheel; young woman Anna (short hair, light-colored coat) struggles in terror in the driver's seat, and Bob shouts: "Stop the car now!" The image is a medium shot, filmed from the front passenger seat toward the driver's seat, with violently shaky handheld camera movement to emphasize the chaos, diagonal composition.
quote: Stop the car now!

text: Inside the same car cabin, short-haired young man Carl in the back seat (wearing a gray T-shirt) looks tense and shouts: "What are you doing? Let go!" while reaching out to pull Bob away. The shot is a close shot, a low-angle upward shot from the front row, quickly panning right (Pan) to follow his pulling motion, using a tilted composition (Dutch Angle) to heighten the tension.
quote: What are you doing? Let go!

text: At the car's driver's seat, Anna forcefully pushes Bob's hand away, her face full of anxiety and anger, questioning: "Are you crazy? There's going to be an accident!" The image is a facial close-up from a fixed dashboard perspective, shallow depth of field, with the camera producing slight high-frequency physical vibration along with the car body, center composition.
quote: Are you crazy? There's going to be an accident!

text: On a modern rainy day inside a retro café, warm yellow light filters through misted glass windows, and two cups of steaming coffee sit on the wooden table by the window. A young woman with sleek short hair, red lipstick, and a black turtleneck sweater is lowering her head, idly stirring her coffee; a middle-aged man wearing half-rim glasses, looking extremely nervous, and dressed in a dark blue coat hurries into frame from the left, pulls out a chair and sits opposite her, pushes a kraft paper envelope across the table, leans forward, lowers his voice, and says, "Everything is in here. Don't forget what you promised me." The woman stops what she is doing and slowly raises her head to look at the envelope. The frame gradually pushes in from a wide shot to a medium shot, with a slow rightward arcing pan (Arc Shot), using rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Everything is in here. Don't forget what you promised me.

text: Inside the same retro café, in a tight close-up of the middle-aged man, he uneasily glances back to the right, beads of sweat faintly appearing on his forehead, reaches up to adjust his slightly slipping glasses, and continues urging in an anxious tone, "Confirm it quickly. Once you've finished checking it, I have to leave right away. This place isn't safe." The frame is shot at a slightly low angle, with a fixed position combined with a slow zoom-in (Zoom In), strongly compressing the character's space to emphasize the tense atmosphere, using centered composition.
quote: Confirm it quickly. Once you've finished checking it, I have to leave right away. This place isn't safe.

text: Still in the café on the rainy day, the young woman with sleek short hair appears in a close shot; the frame uses an over-the-shoulder shot, focusing on the woman's face over the man's left shoulder. The corner of her mouth curls into a calm, cold smile, she reaches out and firmly presses down on the envelope, and replies softly, "Don't worry. I always keep my word. The balance I promised you will arrive in your account immediately." The focus quickly shifts (Rack Focus) from the blurred man's shoulder and envelope in the foreground to the woman's sharply clear face, then the camera tilts slightly left to form a Dutch angle (Dutch Angle), increasing the sense of psychological imbalance and dramatic tension in the frame.
quote: Don't worry. I always keep my word. The balance I promised you will arrive in your account immediately.

text: Inside the same café, shot from outside through the glass window covered with raindrops, the middle-aged man suddenly springs to his feet, staring in terror at the street to the right outside the window, and hurriedly throws a line to the woman, "There's no time. Someone is onto us. Split up!" After saying this, he quickly turns around and prepares to leave, and the woman also instantly drops her smile, grabs the envelope, and stands up. The frame is a medium shot, using a handheld-camera-style tracking shot; the camera rapidly tilts up with the characters' sudden rising movement and follows left (Whip Pan), with a slight sense of shake in the image, greatly heightening the feeling of urgent escape, using scattered composition.
quote: There's no time. Someone is onto us. Split up!

text: In an ancient town square at night, with red light flickering, the villager Daqiang, wearing a red festival mask, stands at the very front of the crowd, excitedly waving and shouting: "The show is starting!". The image is a medium shot, with a rapid pan from right to left, using a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: The show is starting!

text: In the square, fireworks comically explode around the crowd, and Daqiang dodges in panic, shouting in disbelief: "This is way too over the top!". The image is a wide shot, with handheld cinematography creating a realistic sense of shake, using a scattered composition.
quote: This is way too over the top!

text: Daytime, inside a Japanese-style dojo, the bearded white coach John stands in the center, his limbs tightly held by four Asian trainees. John looks relaxed and says with a smile, "Pay attention to the shift in the center of gravity." The image is a wide shot, an orbiting tracking shot, with a centered composition.
quote: Pay attention to the shift in the center of gravity.

text: Around the tatami mats in the dojo, the onlookers all applaud and laugh. John smiles as he straightens his gi and says to the trainees getting up, "This is using force against force." The trainees bow with ashamed expressions and withdraw, then bring over a small wooden table. The image is a wide shot, an eye-level locked-off shot that turns into a slight pan, with a scattered composition.
quote: This is using force against force.

text: On a classical stone balcony, the purple-haired cloaked noble Daisuke stands beside a column, looking down from above, murmuring, "This is..." The camera tilts down from the sky, transitioning into an over-the-shoulder medium shot.
quote: This is...

text: On the same balcony, Daisuke holds up a wanted poster for a boy with a bounty of 1000 gold coins. He whispers in voiceover, "So someone like this really does exist. Capturing him is worth 1000 gold coins. He really is a big bad guy." The camera shows a close-up of the wanted poster, slowly panning downward, with a shallow depth of field.
quote: So someone like this really does exist. Capturing him is worth 1000 gold coins. He really is a big bad guy.

text: Inside the balcony, Daisuke holds the wanted poster, his expression turning excited and greedy, and says excitedly, "But if I can catch him, maybe they'll recognize me as king!" The camera is in a medium close-up, slowly pushing forward (Dolly in), with an eye-level rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: But if I can catch him, maybe they'll recognize me as king!

text: In a stone colonnade, Daisuke clutches the wanted poster to his chest. Behind him, two translucent ghost servants appear, and one of them says flatly, "Young master, let's set out." Daisuke's eyes are resolute, and he smiles as he clenches both fists. The camera slowly pushes forward from a wide shot to a medium shot, with a symmetrical composition, and the focus smoothly shifts from the ghosts behind him to Daisuke's face.
quote: Young master, let's set out.

text: Deep in the forest, a tight close-up of male explorer one. He stops and looks up at the spores drifting down through the air, his brow slightly furrowed, and quietly warns in English: "The ecosystem here is very unusual. Everyone, be careful." The image is a locked-off shot, with shallow depth of field, the focus concentrated on the character's face, and the background plants blurred.
quote: The ecosystem here is very unusual. Everyone, be careful.

text: On the same battlefield, the swordsman in blue robes bears battle damage on his face, grits his teeth, grips his sword, and presses forward, shouting sternly: "I will never allow you to destroy this realm!" The camera quickly pushes in from a medium shot to a close-up of the white-haired swordsman in blue robes' face, with shallow depth of field focus and surging energy in the background.
quote: I will never allow you to destroy this realm!

text: Still on the battlefield, red markings flicker across the red-clad witch's face, her gaze sharp as she exerts force to press the blade back and sneers: "Hypocrite, pay the price!" The camera uses an arc-shaped orbit movement, smoothly panning from over the shoulder to a close-up near shot of the white-haired witch in red, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Hypocrite, pay the price!

text: In a neon-lit street-corner café on a modern rainy night, rain beats against the glass outside the window, and the interior lighting is dim and warm-toned. Lin Hao, a young man with messy black choppy hair, an extremely tense expression, and a dark long trench coat, is sitting in a booth, pushing a small silver metal box across the table; Su Na, a young woman with silver ear-length short hair, a cold, stern gaze, and a black biker leather jacket, sits opposite him with her arms crossed. Lin Hao leans forward and says in a low, anxious voice: "All the information is inside. Whatever you do, don't open it while the system is connected to the network." The image is a medium shot, with the camera slowly arcing and panning from right to left (Arc shot), using the coffee cup on the table as a blurred foreground element, finally settling on a side view of the two seated face-to-face, in a diagonal composition.
quote: All the information is inside. Whatever you do, don't open it while the system is connected to the network.

text: In the same rainy-night café, in a close-up of the young woman Su Na, she does not look at the box on the table, but her eyes shift slightly as she glances out the window from the corner of her eye. Feigning composure, she picks up the coffee cup and takes a sip, then says in a calm tone with a warning edge: "You were followed. There's a black car outside the window at three o'clock." The image uses an eye-level close shot, with the camera slowly pushing in (Push in), while the focus smoothly shifts from the metal box to her eyes, shallow depth of field, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: You were followed. There's a black car outside the window at three o'clock.

text: Still inside the dimly lit café, upon hearing this, the young man Lin Hao instantly panics and instinctively wants to turn his head to look outside, but Su Na quickly reaches out and presses down on his wrist to stop him. Lin Hao breathes rapidly, forcing himself to stay calm, and asks shakily: "Then what do we do now?" The image uses an over-the-shoulder shot, focusing on Lin Hao from over Su Na's shoulder, with a slight handheld shake to heighten the tension, then following Su Na's motion as she presses down on his wrist with a tiny, quick tilt downward (Tilt down), center-point composition.
quote: Then what do we do now?

text: In the narrow back alley of the modern rainy-night café, rain is pouring down, and the ground is covered with puddles reflecting red and blue neon light. Su Na suddenly shoves open the iron door and rushes into the rain with Lin Hao, who is tightly clutching the metal box. Su Na warily scans the surroundings, turns back, and commands in a low, decisive voice: "Take the back alley. Stay close to me. Don't look back." The image is a wide shot, filmed from a low angle looking upward, with the camera quickly pulling back as it follows their footsteps, accompanied by a slight lateral tracking move (Tracking and Dolly out), leading-line composition, creating a strong sense of escape and a suspenseful atmosphere.
quote: Take the back alley. Stay close to me. Don't look back.

text: On a neon-flickering elevated runway in a futuristic city at night, a young man in a cyan jacket with a punk hairstyle is running, drenched in sweat; beside him, a young woman in a purple-and-green color-block hoodie runs alongside him with ease. The image uses a side-on lateral tracking shot, quickly pushing in to a medium shot of the two, with a rule-of-thirds composition. The young man looks at her, panting, and asks, "Why? (Why are you asking that?)".
quote: Why? (Why are you asking that?)

text: On the same elevated runway, the young woman maintains a steady pace. The shot uses an orbiting tracking shot, smoothly pushing in to a close shot from the chest up, from a 45-degree side high angle. Looking straight ahead, she says in a flat tone, "Honestly, you don't look cut out for it. (Honestly, you don't seem like that type of person)".
quote: Honestly, you don't look cut out for it. (Honestly, you don't seem like that type of person)

text: On the runway under the night sky, the young man's expression freezes, and sweat slides down from his forehead. The image is a low-angle close-up, combined with a fast push-in that dynamically focuses on his profile, with a diagonal composition. Unconvinced, he grits his teeth and shoots back, "How? (How am I not?)".
quote: How? (How am I not?)

text: Inside a simple adobe house, the light is dim. A slightly chubby young man wearing round-framed glasses (Li Ming) has his eyes tightly shut, his face full of tension. A young woman with twin ponytails (Wang Hong) raises her hand as if to strike. The image begins in close-up, handheld with a slight wobble; as the palm closes in, it suddenly stops, and the camera slowly pulls back to a medium shot. Li Ming opens his eyes and asks with a smug smile, "What's wrong, can't bring yourself to do it?" Diagonal composition.
quote: What's wrong, can't bring yourself to do it?

text: Still inside the adobe house, using a medium shot with an orbiting camera movement. The camera rotates half a circle around Li Ming as he covers his left cheek, laughs brightly, and teases, "Just that one touch? I'm not washing this side of my face for the next half month. If it's not too much trouble, could you do this side too?" The people in the background snicker. Center composition.
quote: Just that one touch? I'm not washing this side of my face for the next half month. If it's not too much trouble, could you do this side too?

text: Inside the adobe house, a wide shot follows with a pan. Wang Hong frowns in shy annoyance and says coyly, "I hate you, go, go, go!" She reaches out and pushes Li Ming outside, and the camera pans right with her movement, showing the warm atmosphere of everyone in the room laughing. Scattered composition.
quote: I hate you, go, go, go!

text: Illuminated by the red light, Lin's gaze is dark, the corners of her mouth lift slightly, and she says in an icy tone: "Scared? Then don't look." The shot uses a highly tense rapid whip pan (Whip Pan), switching swiftly between Feng's horrified expression and Lin's face, finally freezing on a slight high-angle close-up of Lin, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Scared? Then don't look.

text: In a bright indoor skating rink, the ice surface is broad. A middle-aged coach wearing a blue hoodie and a black hat stands side by side with a young male team member wearing a blue team uniform and a yellow helmet. The camera slowly pushes in from a wide shot and pans left, settling on a medium shot. The coach announces to everyone, "This is Wang Yu. Starting today, he joins us and will be responsible for leading the women's team in speed training." The image is at eye level, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: This is Wang Yu. Starting today, he joins us and will be responsible for leading the women's team in speed training.

text: In the same skating rink, the young male team member looks relaxed. The camera first uses an over-the-shoulder angle, then makes a half-orbit track around him. He smiles and introduces himself: "Hello, everyone. Personally, I like punk. I think it's really cool." The image is a close shot, with dynamic composition.
quote: Hello, everyone. Personally, I like punk. I think it's really cool.

text: In the skating rink, the camera whip-pans quickly from the coach to the lined-up team members, then rapidly pushes in to a close-up of the short-haired female team member. The coach gives a stern order: "Lin Xiao, move back to the dorm. From now on, everyone lives together." Lin Xiao is expressionless and watches in silence. The image is at eye level, with a centered composition.
quote: Lin Xiao, move back to the dorm. From now on, everyone lives together.

text: In the skating rink, the camera initially looks up at the coach, then the crane rises and pulls back. The coach shouts, "Relay training officially begins. Let's go!" The team members applaud and disperse, and the camera shifts into a smooth tracking shot following the short-haired female team member as she turns and skates away, her brows slightly furrowed. The image cuts from a close shot to an expansive wide shot, with a following composition.
quote: Relay training officially begins. Let's go!

text: In an ancient, desolate relay station, the sunlight is dim yellow. A purple-robed merchant walks toward a steamer basket giving off white steam. Wide tracking shot, the camera pushes in and pans left. He stops in front of a homespun-clad stall vendor and asks, ""Brother, why has there been no one in town these past two days? What happened?""
quote: Brother, why has there been no one in town these past two days? What happened?

text: In front of the stall, over-the-shoulder shot, the focus shifts from the purple-robed merchant to the homespun-clad stall vendor. The homespun-clad stall vendor looks around nervously and says in a low voice, ""You just got here, so you don't know. There's a plague going around, many people have died, who would dare go out!"" Close shot, slight low angle, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: You just got here, so you don't know. There's a plague going around, many people have died, who would dare go out!

text: In front of the stall, the purple-robed merchant's brow is tightly furrowed. Close-up, the camera slowly pushes in, centered composition. He urgently presses, ""What plague is so virulent?""
quote: What plague is so virulent?

text: In front of the stall, the homespun-clad stall vendor points into the town. Medium shot, the camera slowly moves right with the gesture. With worry and fear on his face, he says, ""It's called 'cattle plague.' If you can't pull through, you're dead in a dozen or so days. Catching it is no small matter.""
quote: It's called 'cattle plague.' If you can't pull through, you're dead in a dozen or so days. Catching it is no small matter.

text: An ancient-style courtyard on a dark night, dimly lit. The injured elder, Uncle Wu, has fallen to the ground, and the young swordsman Jianchen and the young woman Liuli rush to his side in panic. Jianchen shouts urgently: "Uncle Wu!" The image uses a dynamic tracking shot that rapidly tilts upward from a low position close to the ground, paired with a low-angle composition.
quote: Uncle Wu!

text: Inside the same courtyard. The cold, ruthless guard commander advances with his soldiers. He glares ahead and waves his hand to give the order: "Seize these two and await judgment!" The shot uses camera movement that rapidly dollies in to a facial close-up, with a slightly tilted Dutch-angle composition and an extremely shallow depth of field.
quote: Seize these two and await judgment!

text: The courtyard ground. The elder Uncle Wu lies collapsed on the ground in pain, looks at the two people breaking through the encirclement, and anxiously shouts: "Don't worry about me, hurry and go!" The shot uses a high-angle overhead close-up, slowly pushing in to focus on his facial expression.
quote: Don't worry about me, hurry and go!

text: In a modern apartment bedroom, a young man wearing glasses and gray clothing stands, while a long-haired young woman wearing blue sits on the bed. The camera slowly pushes in from a medium shot to a close shot of the young man, and he lowers his head and says with a grave expression: "My sister and I discussed it, and we're planning to hire a long-term caregiver for my uncle, someone more experienced."
quote: My sister and I discussed it, and we're planning to hire a long-term caregiver for my uncle, someone more experienced.

text: In the same bedroom, the camera moves on a semi-orbiting track toward a side close shot of the long-haired young woman. She raises her head slightly, her brow faintly furrowed, her eyes filled with probing concern, and asks cautiously: "How much would that cost?"
quote: How much would that cost?

text: Still in the bedroom, the camera shoots the young man from a low angle looking up and slowly tracks left. He appears somewhat hesitant and uneasy, avoids eye contact, and answers in a low voice: "About eight thousand yuan a month."
quote: About eight thousand yuan a month.

text: In the same bedroom, the camera makes a rapid push-in to a close-up of the long-haired young woman's face. Her eyes instantly widen, her face full of shock, and she waves both hands excitedly as she shouts: "Eight thousand? Are you kidding me? With the mortgage and the car loan on top of that, how are we supposed to live?"
quote: Eight thousand? Are you kidding me? With the mortgage and the car loan on top of that, how are we supposed to live?

text: In a grand ancient hall with a dark palette and flickering firelight, a crane shot slowly descends from a high extreme wide shot and pushes forward into a medium shot, with a symmetrical composition. A commanding king in ornate black-and-red robes, with a beard, sits upright on a high dais, his brow tightly furrowed as he loudly rebukes them: "Since I conferred titles upon the lords of the various provinces, three months have passed, yet you still linger in the capital!"
quote: Since I conferred titles upon the lords of the various provinces, three months have passed, yet you still linger in the capital!

text: In the same grand hall, the camera uses a low-angle, upward-looking tracking movement, moving laterally to the right and sweeping past the assembled ministers standing below, with a rule-of-thirds composition. Several senior ministers in gray-and-red long robes lower their heads in silence, looking uneasy. The king's voice comes in voiceover, suppressing his anger: "Keeping the army stationed consumes enormous resources, and provisions are already becoming impossible to sustain!"
quote: Keeping the army stationed consumes enormous resources, and provisions are already becoming impossible to sustain!

text: Before the throne in the grand hall, the camera uses an arc movement (Arc Shot) to orbit around the king's side, then smoothly pushes forward to a close shot from the chest up, with a center-point composition. His gaze is sharp, his body leans forward, and he issues an order in a forceful tone: "I give you half a month to break camp and withdraw, and return to your own domains!"
quote: I give you half a month to break camp and withdraw, and return to your own domains!

text: In the dim, oppressive grand hall, the camera first pauses briefly on the ministers' terrified faces, then uses a rapid whip pan (Whip Pan) to cut precisely back to a close-up of the king's face, in a fixed eye-level shot. Through gritted teeth, he delivers the final ultimatum word by word: "Those who do not withdraw by the deadline will be stripped of their titles and demoted to commoners! Is that understood?" The entire hall falls into dead silence.
quote: Those who do not withdraw by the deadline will be stripped of their titles and demoted to commoners! Is that understood?

text: At the main seat opposite the ancient-style trial platform on the water, the official, Lord Zhang, in a blue robe and red hat, wears a grave expression. The deputy whispers, "My lord, the hour has come." The camera slowly pushes in from a medium shot to a close-up, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: My lord, the hour has come.

text: The crowd on the shore, a young man in blue named Afu shouts anxiously, "My lord, he is innocent!" People beside him weep. The camera quickly pushes past a guard's shoulder to Afu's face, with a slight handheld shake, rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: My lord, he is innocent!

text: At the main seat, Lord Zhang closes his eyes and sighs, grabs a redwood command token and hurls it to the ground, shouting, "Cut off the shackles, release him as innocent!" The camera starts in a close-up of the hand and follows the command token with a rapid pan downward to the ground, diagonal composition.
quote: Cut off the shackles, release him as innocent!

text: In the same classical study, Xiaomei looks anxious, steps forward, grabs Hall Master Li's sleeve, and says loudly: "Stop composing poetry, hurry and come with me!" The image uses an over-the-shoulder shot, with the focus quickly shifting from the poetry scroll to Xiaomei's anxious face, after which the camera pulls back to follow the two as they leave.
quote: Stop composing poetry, hurry and come with me!

text: In the same medicine shop, after taking a deep inhale, the fat patient suddenly tilts his head back in pain and cries out, spewing thick smoke and frowning as he complains: "What kind of treatment is this? It's like being smoked and scorched!". The image uses a rapid push-in to a close-up of the character's face, with a slight low angle and a centered composition, highlighting his comical stress reaction.
quote: What kind of treatment is this? It's like being smoked and scorched!

text: Still in the medicine shop, the old doctor calmly tells him not to yell yet, and to feel how his headache is. The fat patient tentatively touches his head, his expression turning to surprise and delight: "It doesn't hurt anymore!". The doctor proudly instructs the assistant to prepare the medicine. The shot is a two-person medium shot, at eye level, with a slight left-right pan accompanying the two characters' interaction.
quote: It doesn't hurt anymore!

text: In the same room, a man with long curly hair shows concern, leaning forward to comfort her: "Your chronic illness can finally be cured; you should be happy."; a close-shot close-up, the camera pans slightly, with diagonal composition.
quote: Your chronic illness can finally be cured; you should be happy.

text: Still in the room, the woman raises her eyes slightly, her gaze filled with desolation, and says softly: "I was thinking, if my father were still alive…"; an over-the-shoulder shot, the focus locked on the woman, with the background blurred.
quote: I was thinking, if my father were still alive…

text: The woman's emotions gradually intensify, her eyes slightly reddening as she adds: "He would surely be very happy."; a medium close-up, an eye-level locked-off shot, center composition, highlighting the sorrowful emotion.
quote: He would surely be very happy.

text: On the country lane, Aunt Wang is shocked at the sight and hurriedly bends down, reaching out both hands to try to help Xiaofang up, shouting anxiously, "Oh no, get up, are you hurt?" The shot uses an over-the-shoulder close-up, focusing on Aunt Wang from behind Xiaofang's shoulder, with an eye-level locked-off camera and centered composition.
quote: Oh no, get up, are you hurt?

text: Beside the muddy lane, Old Li, a plain, honest man with a shaved head and a grayish-white short-sleeve shirt, enters frame from the left, quickly steps forward to help lift the fallen bicycle, and says warmly, "This lousy road is too slippery. I'll help you push it up." The frame is a wide shot, with the camera panning right to follow the character's movement, using scattered-point composition.
quote: This lousy road is too slippery. I'll help you push it up.

text: On the lane, Xiaofang uses the support to stand up, somewhat embarrassed as she pats the mud off her pant legs, and replies with a helpless smile, "Thank you, Uncle Li. I was really too clumsy today." The frame is a medium close shot, a locked-off camera with a slightly high angle, using rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Thank you, Uncle Li. I was really too clumsy today.

text: In a modern, brightly lit villa living room, a woman in a white shirt with her hair in an updo stands beside the sofa, wearing a chillingly stiff smile. A young woman in a brown hoodie pleads in extreme panic: "Please... let it go!" Then the young woman cries out and falls, crawling toward the stairs. The image begins with a slow push-in close-up on the woman with her hair in an updo, then cuts via a fast whip pan to an overhead wide shot of the young woman falling, with a diagonal composition.
quote: Please... let it go!

text: At the staircase of the same villa, the young woman clings to the handrail and backs away, shouting in despair: "No, no, no!" The woman with her hair in an updo keeps her eerie smile, steps straight onto the sofa, and advances step by step. The image uses a low-angle Steadicam tracking shot, pulling back from the young woman's point of view while shooting up at the woman with her hair in an updo, with a perspective leading-line composition.
quote: No, no, no!

text: At the stair landing, the young woman is forced into a corner with nowhere left to retreat. The woman with her hair in an updo suddenly steps forward and clamps a hand tightly over her mouth, leaning close to her cheek and whispering: "You can't hide it anymore." The image uses a psychologically oppressive Dutch-angle over-the-shoulder shot, with a fast crash zoom into an extreme close two-shot of the two women, in a tight composition.
quote: You can't hide it anymore.

text: In a dim, retro apartment room, a man in a striped sweater viciously grabs at a black bag on the floor; the man in a floral shirt who has fallen to the ground scrambles backward in panic and shouts, "Don't touch my things!" A medium shot quickly pushes in to a close shot, with handheld cinematography and noticeable shake, using a canted composition.
quote: Don't touch my things!

text: In the dim stairwell, a woman in a floral top hears the commotion and looks up in terror, murmuring softly, "What's going on?" A low-angle upward shot, then a slow tilt up to focus on her face, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: What's going on?

text: Inside the apartment room, the man in the floral shirt quickly grabs a metal clothes-drying rack as a shield and holds it in front of him, while the man in the striped sweater lunges forward angrily and roars, "Give it to me!" An over-the-shoulder shot cuts in, then a fast pan reveals the standoff, with centered composition.
quote: Give it to me!

text: In the stairwell, the woman in the floral top looks anxious, rushes up the stairs, and shouts, "You two stop!" An eye-level tracking follow shot, pushing forward with her movement, with the background defocused and rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: You two stop!

text: In the same living room, Lao Zhang's face is full of rage, his breathing rapid, his eyes sharp as he glares at the person beneath him. The image is a close shot with a slow push-in, using a tilted Dutch-angle composition, as the focus shifts quickly and smoothly from Xiao Li's struggling hand to Lao Zhang's face. Lao Zhang says through gritted teeth, "Calm down? You think I'm joking?".
quote: Calm down? You think I'm joking?

text: Still in the living room, Lao Zhang raises his fist high, but in the end angrily slams it down hard onto the sofa cushion beside Xiao Li's ear, restraining himself from hurting anyone. The image uses a fast whip pan, snapping instantly from a terrified close-up of Xiaomei to the fist smashing down, then the camera follows Lao Zhang as he gets up with an upward tilt. Xiaomei breaks down and shouts, "What do you want!".
quote: What do you want!

text: Inside the apartment, Xiaomei rushes forward to protect Xiao Li on the floor, then gets up, points at the front door, and sternly orders Lao Zhang to leave. The image uses a 360-degree orbiting tracking arc movement with a wide-angle lens, showing the tension of the standoff between the two sides. Xiaomei warns sharply, "Get out! I'm calling the police!".
quote: Get out! I'm calling the police!

text: In the same living room, David, a bearded man, lies on the sofa, staring at an old-fashioned television, indifferently answering the quiz show on TV: "What is the epidermis?" He completely ignores the scuffle behind him. The shot smoothly pushes in from a medium shot to a close-up of his face, with shallow depth of field blurring the fight in the background, using a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: What is the epidermis?

text: Inside the apartment, after overturning the clutter, Anna suddenly turns back and spots Lily. Desperate and frenzied, she grabs her hair with both hands and advances toward the girl, commanding in a low voice, "Give it to me, that's mine." An over-the-shoulder tracking shot is used, panning from Lily's perspective and slowly zooming in on Anna's face, with a centered composition.
quote: Give it to me, that's mine.

text: The same deck. Ajian holds Lao Zheng down with one hand, leans out, and shouts downward: "Don't move, this place is full of our people!" Use a low-angle Dutch-angle composition, with the camera position slightly shaking to heighten the urgency.
quote: Don't move, this place is full of our people!

text: Inside a dimly lit upscale lawyer's office, a laptop and a gavel sit on a solid-wood desk. A middle-aged senior male lawyer in a dark suit braces both hands on the desk, his expression tense. The medium shot slowly pushes in, creating a sense of oppression. He says coldly into the phone, "If the agreement gets screwed up, we'll all be out."
quote: If the agreement gets screwed up, we'll all be out.

text: In the same office, a young female lawyer in business attire enters, pushing the door open while holding documents, her expression slightly panicked. The camera crosses from behind the middle-aged senior male lawyer, using an over-the-shoulder shot and slowly orbiting to the right as it tracks the young female lawyer. She stops in front of the desk, takes a deep breath, and says, "Richard, the other side refuses to sign and is preparing to sue."
quote: Richard, the other side refuses to sign and is preparing to sue.

text: After the crisp sound of shattering, the office falls into dead silence. The young female lawyer takes a slight half-step back, but quickly steadies herself, her gaze becoming resolute. The shot pulls back to a medium close-up, filmed at eye level with a fixed camera, using rule-of-thirds composition. She looks directly at the senior lawyer, her tone calm and firm: "Getting angry is useless. We still have 24 hours to prepare a response strategy."
quote: Getting angry is useless. We still have 24 hours to prepare a response strategy.

text: In a dim, ancient-style secret chamber, the red-clad woman Wan'er is bound and kneeling on the ground, gagged with a strip of cloth. The black-clad guard Shadow stands beside her, looking toward Li Xingyun, the young nobleman in brocade robes opposite him, and says helplessly: "I have no way to deal with her. If you want to put this matter to rest, you'll need to persuade her more." The image uses a pushing-in over-the-shoulder shot, slowly shifting from a high angle to eye level, with a slight handheld wobble, composed according to the rule of thirds.
quote: I have no way to deal with her. If you want to put this matter to rest, you'll need to persuade her more.

text: Inside the secret chamber, Li Xingyun looks solemn. He responds in a deep voice: "She may appear delicate, but her will is extremely resolute. Once she has made up her mind, she never turns back. I can't sway her." The shot uses an orbiting dolly tracking shot, smoothly orbiting 180 degrees from the side to a frontal close-up, with the background blurred in shallow depth of field and a centered composition.
quote: She may appear delicate, but her will is extremely resolute. Once she has made up her mind, she never turns back. I can't sway her.

text: Inside the secret chamber, after a moment of silence, Shadow sighs and compromises, gripping the hilt of the sword in his hand tightly as he says: "Forget it. Today I was foolish. Take her with you." The image uses a rapid push-in to a half-body shot, then the camera quickly tracks right following his line of sight, with high-contrast light and shadow and a golden-ratio composition.
quote: Forget it. Today I was foolish. Take her with you.

text: In an autumn ancient-architecture courtyard, beneath a towering tree with golden fallen leaves, the camera slowly tilts down from the canopy, transitioning to a low-angle wide shot that reveals the stone table by the stream. The young woman Xiaowan, dressed in light-green period costume, sits upright; opposite her is the black-robed man Mochen, while the white-clad man Baiyu stands beside them. Xiaowan's gaze is sharp as she questions him: "May I ask, sir, where were you at nightfall three days ago? Who can vouch for you?" The image has warm colors and a centered composition.
quote: May I ask, sir, where were you at nightfall three days ago? Who can vouch for you?

text: Beside the stone table by the stream, the camera slowly pushes in to a close shot of Mochen. Calm and composed, he pours tea, his long hair draped over his shoulders. The image cuts to an extreme close-up of his lips, then pans and tracks to Xiaowan's face. Mochen lifts his eyes, his tone even yet carrying a sense of pressure: "You know full well you are no match for me, so why still come to see me?" Rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: You know full well you are no match for me, so why still come to see me?

text: Amid the autumn scenery of the courtyard, the camera first pulls back rapidly to a wide shot, where the red-clad woman Hongling stops and watches in the background; then it suddenly pushes in fast, refocusing on a close-up of Xiaowan's face. Her eyes blaze as she declares without the slightest fear: "If I die, it will prove that you are connected to the massacre. Trading my life for the truth is worth it." Locked-off eye-level shot, center-point composition.
quote: If I die, it will prove that you are connected to the massacre. Trading my life for the truth is worth it.

text: Inside a dim, classical great hall, A Qing, a young man in white with a hair ribbon, and his companions crouch behind a stone table, raising a golden tray to block the incoming concealed weapons. The frame is shot from a low angle looking upward, the camera rapidly panning with the trajectory of the concealed weapons, then rushing in to a tense close-up of A Qing. He shouts: "Watch out!" Rule-of-thirds composition, flickering light and shadow.
quote: Watch out!

text: Everyone rushes toward the large central stone table, climbing onto the tabletop one after another and raising the trays above their heads to form a defensive formation, blocking the concealed weapons from above. The camera shoots from a high angle looking down, slowly rotating and pulling back to reveal their defensive formation. Old Li grits his teeth and commands: "Watch out! Up!" Centrally symmetrical composition.
quote: Watch out! Up!

text: On the stone table, the assault of concealed weapons suddenly intensifies. As A Qing swings the tray to block, he loses his balance, the defensive line collapses, and everyone falls to the ground one after another. The camera first tilts up quickly to the hall ceiling, then rapidly pulls back and tilts down, using selective slow motion to capture the moment of the fall, finally freezing on a wide shot. A Qing cries out in shock: "We can't hold them off!" Scattered composition.
quote: We can't hold them off!

text: In a dim medical room, short-haired assistant Xiao Wang looks dejected. White-haired Dr. Lin pats him on the shoulder and says, "No money? I'll help you do it the cheap way." The camera pushes in from a medium shot to a close-up, tracking with a slight pan.
quote: No money? I'll help you do it the cheap way.

text: Inside the same arena, the camera rapidly pushes in from a close shot to a close-up of Xiaying@character1's face. Her gaze is sharp, her expression fearless, as she loudly declares: "We end this right here!" The image uses a low-angle upward shot, with slight camera shake to enhance the impact, center-point composition.
quote: We end this right here!

text: On a retro neon-lit street, the night is dim. The silver-haired young swordsman in white, @character1, stands in front of a martial arts school covered with seals, looking at the challenge text message on his phone, and says in a low voice, "Looks like I have no choice but to show up." The image uses a crane shot, starting from a high-angle wide shot looking down at the neon signs, slowly descending and pushing in to an over-the-shoulder close-up of the young man, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Looks like I have no choice but to show up.

text: On the same street, a short-haired young man with glasses and a girl in red walk up beside him. The girl says with a determined gaze, "Let's take the martial arts school back together!" The shot uses a quick whip pan (Whip Pan), rapidly swinging from @character1's face to a close shot of the two from the chest up, then cuts to a low-angle tracking shot, with a slight handheld shake.
quote: Let's take the martial arts school back together!

text: On the other side of the courtyard, the girl in red leaps into the air, flips over the guards' heads, and lands steadily; the young man with glasses follows through by using a wooden saber to block a long staff, shouting, "Don't get in the way, we don't want to hurt anyone!" The image uses a crash zoom (Crash Zoom), first capturing the girl's tumble in a wide shot, then crash-zooming at the instant she lands to a waist-up medium shot of the young man, with diagonal composition.
quote: Don't get in the way, we don't want to hurt anyone!

text: In the center of the courtyard, dust rises faintly. Seeing this, the guards back away, and the silver-haired young man @character1 puts away his wooden sword, calmly looking ahead: "The sparring ends here. Return it to its rightful owner." The shot uses a low-angle wide shot, slowly pulling back (Dolly Out) with a slight upward angle, presenting an expansive image of the standoff subsiding.
quote: The sparring ends here. Return it to its rightful owner.

That means they aren't afraid of being exposed at all, or they're confident they can get away unscathed." The image uses an over-the-shoulder shot, looking past the old man's shoulder, as the camera slowly dollies in (Dolly in) toward the knight's back, with a slight low angle.
quote: The other side can manipulate black magic, yet deliberately left the body behind without hiding it. That means they aren't afraid of being exposed at all, or they're confident they can get away unscathed.

text: Inside a sunny, tech-style dorm, light streams in through the large windows. The black-haired boy Spark @character1, wearing a blue combat suit, is standing tensely; the silver-haired boy Silver Fox, wearing casual clothes, walks into frame and teases him: "You've been looking at yourself for ten minutes. Nervous about the mission?" The shot uses a low-angle slow push-in, then smoothly pans right to reveal the two of them, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: You've been looking at yourself for ten minutes. Nervous about the mission?

text: In the tech-style dorm, Spark @character1 looks worried as he asks who his partner will be. Silver Fox leans in with a mischievous grin and explains: "Probably the senior, but according to the rules, couples can't dive together." Use an over-the-shoulder shot, with the camera slowly orbiting around the two of them (ArcShot), the focus shifting smoothly between them, with dynamic composition.
quote: Probably the senior, but according to the rules, couples can't dive together.

text: In the same dorm, Spark @character1 lowers his eyes, his expression downcast, and sighs softly: "I just think it's pretty sad." The image is a close-up of his face, with the camera tilting slightly downward as it follows his movement, centered composition.
quote: I just think it's pretty sad.

text: In the dorm, just as Silver Fox reaches out to comfort him, Spark @character1 suddenly raises his head, his gaze sharp, and cuts him off: "I'm not talking about myself. I've always wanted to ask, why have you repeated four years at the academy?" Start from a two-person medium shot, then quickly use a sliding zoom (DollyZoom) to press in on Spark's face, with the background violently defocused to emphasize the sudden tension.
quote: I'm not talking about myself. I've always wanted to ask, why have you repeated four years at the academy?

The black-haired, blue-clad young man Ajie@character1 has just taken his seat; Sect Leader Ning, with long hair and ornate robes, gazes at him and says, "I hear your father is that legendary figure?" The camera slowly pushes forward into a close-up, with a diagonal composition.
quote: I hear your father is that legendary figure?

Ajie@character1 bites his lip tightly, his gaze somber yet resolute. The camera slowly pulls back and rises slightly to a medium shot, with a golden-ratio composition.
quote: The reason cannot be disclosed; only your father can tell you everything.

text: A nighttime, cloud-and-mist-shrouded ancient pagoda on a mountaintop, as the red-clad masked figure Feihuan sweeps through midair. An aerial extreme wide shot opens the scene; the camera rapidly pushes forward and tilts downward, focusing on the middle-aged man Li Feng@character1 lying on the grass. His face is full of anger as he looks up and shouts, "Demon, give me back my son's golden body!"
quote: Demon, give me back my son's golden body!

text: Midair by the ancient pagoda, an extreme close-up of red-clad Feihuan's face. The camera uses a slightly tilted Dutch angle and slowly pushes forward. The blue eyes beneath her mask flicker, the corner of her mouth curls into a cold sneer, and she says mockingly, "Foolish mortal, because of your ignorance, you have plunged the human world into eternal damnation."
quote: Foolish mortal, because of your ignorance, you have plunged the human world into eternal damnation.

text: The full view of the ancient pagoda on the mountaintop, composed as an extreme wide shot. The camera uses a crane to rapidly pull back and rise, creating a high-angle overhead effect. Red-clad Feihuan turns into a streak of red light and flies into the distant night, her lingering voice echoing through the air: "Wait to collect your son's corpse!" Li Feng@character1 remains in place in despair.
quote: Wait to collect your son's corpse!

text: In the wind and snow, the old man Albert @character1 looks shocked, staring fixedly ahead. The shot uses a shallow-depth-of-field facial close-up, accompanied by a slow crash push-in camera movement, with rule-of-thirds composition. He whispers in disbelief: "Is it Tina? Is it really her?"
quote: Is it Tina? Is it really her?

text: The old man Albert @character1 angrily turns and closes in on the young Murphy, sternly questioning him: "She disappeared after the research institute fire. Why did you hide this from me?" The shot uses an over-the-shoulder arc pan (Arc Shot), quickly circling from behind the old man to the young man's side profile, dynamically following them, with a strong sense of oppression.
quote: She disappeared after the research institute fire. Why did you hide this from me?

The old mage with purple skin and white hair says in a deep voice: "Look, he deliberately let himself be swallowed to save people." Rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Look, he deliberately let himself be swallowed to save people.

text: In the same meadow, the camera tilts up from the crystal ball to close-ups of the two faces. The old mage looks serious; the young blue-skinned apprentice mage is utterly shocked and says in sudden realization: "So that's it! He clearly could have won, yet he chose this path!" Eye-level two-person composition.
quote: So that's it! He clearly could have won, yet he chose this path!

text: In the meadow, a close-up of the apprentice mage's face, shot from a slight low angle. He looks excited, his eyes filled with admiration, and exclaims: "Amazing! He's really smart!" Locked-off shot, centered composition.
quote: Amazing! He's really smart!

text: On a futuristic neon-flickering rainy night street, standing water reflects the light. A young man with black tousled hair, wearing a dark tactical jacket, and a young woman with long silver hair, wearing a white combat suit, stand back-to-back, warily watching their surroundings. The camera starts with a high-angle aerial shot, the crane descends and pushes forward to a medium shot; the man grips his dual pistols @prop1 tightly and says in a low voice, "Looks like there's no way out."
