text: In the dim industrial passageway @scene1 on a modern night, metal pipes and rough walls appear oppressive and dangerous under the faint light. A flat tracked robot with a blue indicator light moves quickly forward over the rugged, uneven ground, the camera using an eye-level tracking shot, with the image accompanied by a slight shake, creating a strong sense of tension. At this moment, the voiceover delivers a startled cry from a middle-aged white technician: "What?"; the image is a close-up, with a leading-line composition.
quote: What?

text: In the same dim industrial passageway @scene1, a middle-aged white male technician with blond hair and a high hairline is sitting in front of a computer, operating it. He is wearing a light green shirt over a black T-shirt, and because a sudden situation on the screen causes an operational mistake, his body jerks forward, his facial expression vivid, instantly revealing a look of frustration and disbelief, and he cannot help shouting: "Ah!"; the image uses a close shot, an eye-level static shot, and a center-point composition.
quote: Ah!

text: On the ground of the oppressive industrial passageway @scene1, the tracked robot seems to be stuck on an obstacle, its tracks spinning rapidly in place, kicking up clouds of dust, but the body of the machine still cannot move forward. Accompanied by the technician's anxious urging: "Go up, hurry, go up."; the image uses a close-up, a low-angle static shot looking upward, and a diagonal composition.
quote: Go up, hurry, go up.

text: In the same dim industrial passageway @scene1, a middle-aged white male agent with short dark hair and a face covered in grime is trapped behind a blue metal railing. He is wearing a gray shirt, his hands gripping the railing tightly, his head tilted upward, his face covered in sweat and pain, and he shouts anxiously and helplessly: "Hurry, go up, go up!"; the image uses a close shot, an eye-level static shot, and a frame-within-a-frame composition.
quote: Hurry, go up, go up!

text: In the ancient camp at night @scene1, wooden tables, chairs, tents, and glowing lanterns can be seen all around, with dry straw spread across the ground; the environment is simple yet full of everyday life. A middle-aged white male soldier sits on the dry straw; he has medium-length curly hair and a beard, wears dark ancient Roman-style cloth garments and leather bracers, and his resolute expression carries fatigue and melancholy. He first lowers his head to look at the clay bowl in his hands, then raises his head and looks toward the front right, speaking sadly: "I am a man who has lost his country; living is more painful than death."; after saying this, he raises the bowl to his mouth and takes a sip. The image uses a chest-up close shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a centered composition.
quote: I am a man who has lost his country; living is more painful than death.

text: The shot returns to the middle-aged white soldier; he continues speaking toward the front right with a serious expression, making a slight gesture in front of his chest with his right hand as he speaks to help express himself: "The deputy general I sent to Parthia"; the image uses a chest-up close shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a centered composition.
quote: The deputy general I sent to Parthia

text: This is an insert shot. On a brightly lit tabletop, an overhead angle shows an ornately carved table, with an unfolded peace agreement document laid flat on it. The document is fixed between two scroll rods and is filled with writing. After a hand moves away from the document, the camera slowly pans from left to right with it, fully showing another section of the document and the quill pen beside it. The voiceover continues: "was to retrieve that peace agreement, in the hope that it could prove Thebes's betrayal."; the image uses a partial extreme close-up, an overhead angle, a slow pan from left to right, and a diagonal composition.
quote: was to retrieve that peace agreement, in the hope that it could prove Thebes's betrayal.

text: In a modern, high-tech interrogation room or laboratory @scene1, the cool-toned lighting is bright, the metal walls and central operating table are clearly visible, and the room is separated from the external monitoring room by a huge glass wall. A middle-aged white male agent lies on the operating table, wearing a dark jacket, with short brown hair, slight sweat on his face, and a black leather mask over the lower half of his face. His gaze is calm and sharp as he stares upward, saying in a steady tone: "I read the Berlin files. They were interesting."; the shot uses a facial close-up, a locked-off high-angle shot, and a diagonal composition.
quote: I read the Berlin files. They were interesting.

text: Inside the same cool-toned modern laboratory @scene1, a middle-aged Black male official wears a suit, with a sturdy build, a bald head, and a stern face. He leans downward, his eyes filled with scrutiny and a sense of oppression, and says in a severe tone: "Agent Sam had info only for you, and you didn't report it."; the shot uses a facial close-up, a locked-off low-angle shot, and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Agent Sam had info only for you, and you didn't report it.

text: Still in the bright laboratory @scene1, the middle-aged white male agent is still lying on the operating table, wearing the black leather mask and a dark jacket. He keeps staring upward, his eyes calm yet sharp, with slight sweat on his forehead, and responds in a steady tone: "The Vatican mission wasn't approved either."; the shot uses a facial close-up, a locked-off high-angle shot, and a diagonal composition.
quote: The Vatican mission wasn't approved either.

text: Inside the same modern laboratory @scene1, the middle-aged Black male official continues leaning downward, his brows tightly furrowed, his expression even more severe and angry, his eyes filled with intimidation. He says with added emphasis: "That mission was a disaster."; the shot uses a facial close-up, a locked-off low-angle shot, and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: That mission was a disaster.

text: In a modern, technology-filled laboratory @scene1, the light is bright and cool-toned, and the metal walls and the surgical bed in the center are clearly visible. A middle-aged white agent lies on the surgical bed, wearing a black leather mask over the lower half of his face and a dark jacket. He glares angrily upward, the corners of his mouth lifting slightly into a provocative sneer. He says coldly, "So I'm going to slow things way down, and I'm going to lay down some rules for you." The shot uses a facial close-up, an eye-level static shot, and a centered composition.
quote: So I'm going to slow things way down, and I'm going to lay down some rules for you.

text: Inside the same cool-toned modern laboratory @scene1, the shot uses an unconventional inverted perspective. The face of a middle-aged Black government official appears upside down in the frame; he is wearing a suit, his expression is stern, his gaze intensely oppressive, and there is a trace of a confident smile at the corner of his mouth as he looks down and speaks. He declares with authority and force, "You can look at me with that kind of bitter, resentful gaze, believing I'm a sinner; you can absolutely glare at me like that, use that look to accuse me, to judge me. I don't lie, but I'll tell you the truth: I am willing to dye the national flag red with my own blood, and I will defend this country to the death at all costs." The image is a facial close-up, an inverted-perspective static shot, with a centered composition.
quote: You can look at me with that kind of bitter, resentful gaze, believing I'm a sinner; you can absolutely glare at me like that, use that look to accuse me, to judge me. I don't lie, but I'll tell you the truth: I am willing to dye the national flag red with my own blood, and I will defend this country to the death at all costs.

text: The shot cuts to a close shot from the superhero's chest up; his face, encased in organic steel over his entire body, bears battle scars, and he looks determinedly forward, murmuring in shock, "Oh my God."; the frame uses a center-point composition and an eye-level locked-off camera.
quote: Oh my God.

text: In @scene1, a bustling city street corner on a clear autumn day, the sunlight is bright, with high-rises and passing vehicles visible in the background. A plump calico cat is lying on the shoulder of a middle-aged Black man wearing a light-colored hospital gown, black-rimmed glasses, and a gray felt fedora. The frame is a shoulders-up close-up, an eye-level locked-off shot, with a centered composition. The cat anxiously pats the man's face with its paw, its mouth moving slightly, and says urgently: "Moonwind, I need to get back into my body!"
quote: Moonwind, I need to get back into my body!

text: In the same city street corner @scene1, a middle-aged white street performer with voluminous long curly blond hair, a thick bushy beard, and a small ponytail tied on top of his head appears in the frame. The shot uses an over-the-shoulder angle, filmed from behind the middle-aged Black man's right side, with a locked-off camera, a rule-of-thirds composition, and a medium shot scale. He holds a yellow sign high, leans backward, his expression exaggerated and full of theatricality, and proposes enthusiastically: "Then we must perform a soul-retrieval ceremony."
quote: Then we must perform a soul-retrieval ceremony.

text: Still in the bright street corner @scene1, the frame cuts back to a shoulders-up close-up, an eye-level locked-off shot, with a centered composition. The Black man in the hospital gown and the calico cat lying on his shoulder both raise their eyebrows at the same time, looking confusedly toward the front right, and the cat responds in puzzlement: "A what?"
quote: A what?

text: Against the same street corner @scene1 background, the white street performer appears again in a medium shot, with an over-the-shoulder shot filmed from behind the middle-aged Black man's right side, a locked-off camera, and a rule-of-thirds composition. Completely immersed in his own world, he holds the yellow sign, spins and sways as if dancing, gesticulating as he explains the details with exaggerated body language, his expression entranced and excited as he says: "To return your soul! It's fun, with music and dancing."
quote: To return your soul! It's fun, with music and dancing.

text: In @scene1, a bustling modern city street corner on a clear autumn day, the sunlight is bright, pedestrians come and go on the sidewalk, and high-rise buildings, vehicles, roadside trash cans, and utility poles are visible in the background. A middle-aged Black man wearing light-colored hospital scrubs, black-rimmed glasses, and a gray felt hat has a plump calico cat lying on his shoulder. The man looks anxious, gazing urgently toward the front right, speaking quickly to urge someone on, while the cat on his shoulder also stares forward solemnly. He says urgently: "I must get to Half Note by seven!"; the image uses a shoulder-up close-up, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a center-point composition.
quote: I must get to Half Note by seven!

text: In the same modern street corner @scene1, a white street performer with a thick bushy beard and long curly blond hair tied into small braids, in order to reassure the other person, first does an exaggerated handstand, then quickly gets back up. Holding a yellow sign, he sways his body from side to side, sometimes bending over and sometimes pointing toward the sky, making all kinds of mysterious poses as he explains to the person on the left that they must wait for a specific moment. He says warmly and theatrically: "Wait! Earth and Selflessness must align first."; the image uses a medium shot, an over-the-shoulder shot (filmed from behind the middle-aged Black man's right side), a locked-off shot, and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Wait! Earth and Selflessness must align first.

text: Still in the bright city street corner @scene1, the Black man in hospital scrubs feels confused and impatient with that mystical spiel; he furrows his brow, his expression puzzled as he asks toward the front right for the specific time, while the calico cat on his shoulder also narrows its eyes and looks forward. He asks impatiently: "When is that?"; the image uses a shoulder-up close-up, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a center-point composition.
quote: When is that?

text: In the modern daytime prison visiting room @scene1, the lighting is dim, and rough stone walls and an oppressive, cold atmosphere envelop the surroundings. An elderly white male prisoner initially stands with his back to the camera, then slowly turns left to face the camera head-on. His face is gaunt, his eyes sharp, and he wears a blue one-piece prison uniform; a faint, inscrutable smile appears on his face as he begins to speak: "I'll help you, Jane."; the image uses a medium shot, a static eye-level camera, and center-point composition.
quote: I'll help you, Jane.

text: Inside the same visiting room @scene1, the camera looks over the elderly prisoner's shoulder, focusing on the other side of a thick transparent barrier with circular holes. A young white female agent slowly rises from a crouching position; she has dark shoulder-length hair and wears a dark suit jacket over a shirt and scarf, her focused, serious gaze fixed on the man across the barrier as she asks: "You know who he is?"; the image is a medium shot, a static over-the-shoulder shot, using rule-of-thirds and depth-of-field composition.
quote: You know who he is?

text: The shot cuts back to the elderly prisoner from the front. He still stands before the rough stone wall, maintaining a calm, confident smile, and speaks to the female agent through the barrier, his words carrying a sense of bargaining and insinuation: "Tell me who harmed your patient. Those who wait are rewarded."; the image is a medium shot, a static eye-level camera, and center-point composition.
quote: Tell me who harmed your patient. Those who wait are rewarded.

text: The shot returns to the young female agent. She stands behind the transparent barrier, staring seriously at the elderly prisoner opposite her, quietly listening to his oppressive words. His voice continues to come through: "I've waited, Jane. How long can you wait?"; the image is a medium shot, a static over-the-shoulder shot, with rule-of-thirds and depth-of-field composition.
quote: I've waited, Jane. How long can you wait?

text: In the same engine room @scene1, a middle-aged white chief engineer stands in front of a row of pressure gauges, staring intently at the instrument readings. When the pressure drops to the critical point, he decisively raises his hand to signal a stop and shouts loudly, "Wait!", his expression serious. The image uses a close shot, an eye-level static shot, and a central composition.
quote: Wait!

text: In @scene1, the nighttime interior of a futuristic spaceship, the two sides of a long, narrow cylindrical metal corridor are lined with structured bulkheads, while the gridded floor and overhead strip lights create a cold, oppressive industrial atmosphere. A handheld tracking shot follows with visible camera shake as a young white man (brown curly hair, wearing glasses, a black T-shirt, and khaki trousers) runs past from the right first, looking panicked; immediately afterward, a young white woman (dark short hair, wearing a gray tank top and dark trousers, her resolute face streaked with sweat) quickly follows, holding a rifle. The two run rapidly one after the other toward the depth of the frame, pass through a circular hatch door into a deeper corridor, and the hatch door behind them then closes. A system alert sounds in the background: "Door B44 is closed. Airlock, operate with caution." The image uses a tracking shot from medium shot to wide shot, handheld camerawork, and a leading-line composition.
quote: Door B44 is closed. Airlock, operate with caution.

text: Inside the same dim spaceship corridor in @scene1, a fixed shot is aimed toward the depths of the corridor. The young white woman and the young white man run quickly from the distance toward the camera, their movements hurried and their expressions tense. After passing through a circular hatch door, the two quickly run out of frame, and another hatch door behind them swiftly closes. Accompanied by a system alert: "Door B46 is closed." The shot scale transitions from wide shot to medium shot until the characters exit frame, using a fixed shot and center-point composition.
quote: Door B46 is closed.

text: In the cold spaceship corridor in @scene1, the camera quickly focuses on a heavy metal hatch door marked in yellow with the number "71." The hatch door is closing rapidly, its mechanical structure interlocking tightly. The image uses a medium shot of the hatch door, a fixed shot, and a horizontal composition.

The perspective switches to the interior of a dark surveillance station, with the dark silhouettes of monitoring equipment in the foreground forming a frame composition. Looking through the foreground toward the distant spaceship corridor in @scene1, a hatch door at the end of the corridor is slowly closing, immediately followed by another door also closing rapidly; the light is then completely blocked, and the image gradually falls into darkness. A system broadcast sounds in the background: "Door B47 is closed, Door B45 is closed." The image uses a long shot of the corridor and a fixed shot.
quote: Door B47 is closed, Door B45 is closed.

text: At the nighttime Mexican-style courtyard party in @scene1, the red irregular floor tiles, small central pool, palm trees, and arched gallery look extraordinarily lively under the warm red and yellow lantern light. The image uses a wide shot, a fixed side-angle shot, and a diagonal composition. A fat middle-aged businessman with a thick black beard, wearing a red shirt and a gold chain, stands beside the table, leaning forward with concern as he greets him. Across from him sits a bald, hook-nosed middle-aged man wearing a black jacket and a gray-black striped scarf, his arms crossed, his expression resistant and displeased. Under the businessman's questioning, the middle-aged man reluctantly spreads his hands, forces a smile, and replies: "Hey, what's wrong with you? Oh, nothing. Nothing's wrong. I'm just trying to calm down."
quote: Hey, what's wrong with you? Oh, nothing. Nothing's wrong. I'm just trying to calm down.

text: In the same courtyard @scene1, the image shifts to a medium shot, a fixed side-angle shot, and a rule-of-thirds composition. To cover up his emotions, the middle-aged man waves his hand exaggeratedly, then breaks a piece off the chip hat on his head, puts it in his mouth, and chews it. After eating it, he proudly gives the businessman a thumbs-up, trying to prove that he is fine, his expression shifting from an awkward smile to smugness. The businessman leans forward beside him, watching him, while the middle-aged man continues: "Dip it in guacamole, eat my chip hat. Gru, please."
quote: Dip it in guacamole, eat my chip hat. Gru, please.

text: Inside the same dim library @scene1, the shot shifts to a close-up, focusing on the mage's hands. He slowly opens the ancient book, whose yellowed pages are covered with densely packed writing. The mage says in a low voice, "The book is missing a few pages."; the shot uses a close-up, an overhead locked-off camera, and diagonal composition.
quote: The book is missing a few pages.

text: Still in the mysterious library @scene1, the shot pushes in to a medium close-up. The mage lowers his head and gazes at the ancient book in his hands, then raises his head and explains to the person beside him with a serious, focused expression. He says in a calm, steady tone, "This is the Book of Stars, the study of time. Several pages were stolen by a mage from here."; the shot uses a medium close-up, an eye-level locked-off camera, and center-point composition.
quote: This is the Book of Stars, the study of time. Several pages were stolen by a mage from here.

text: Deep inside the library @scene1 on the same night, a bald, middle-aged Asian male librarian wearing dark, layered robes slowly walks out from behind the dim bookshelves. He is powerfully built, looks ahead with a serious expression, and adds in a low voice, "It was David. He betrayed us and stole them."; the shot uses a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off camera, and center-point composition.
quote: It was David. He betrayed us and stole them.

text: On the same dim alien surface @scene1, the female astronaut has just climbed up when she falls again, and can only crawl across the ground in despair. She raises her head and looks upward in terror as a huge U-shaped spacecraft wreckage rolls over her head, its heavy shadow completely engulfing her, creating an extreme sense of oppression and despair. She whispers in despair: "No..."; the image is a medium shot, an overhead tracking shot, with overhead composition.
quote: No...

text: Beneath the shadow of the huge spacecraft wreckage, the female astronaut makes her final struggle amid the dim smoke and firelight, crawling across the ground with difficult and desperate movements, once again letting out a faint moan: "No..."; the shot is a medium shot, a static shot, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: No...

text: Inside the same bridge @scene1, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of a young white male officer's face. Because of the authorization failure, he briefly lowers his head in frustration, then quickly raises his head and leans in, using exaggerated mouth shapes and repeating the passphrase with great effort, one word at a time: "Ensign-level authorization code 9-5-Victor-Victor-2."; the image uses an eye-level static shot at a 45-degree angle with a centered composition.
quote: Ensign-level authorization code 9-5-Victor-Victor-2.

text: After the authorization succeeds, the young officer's expression relaxes and a faint smile appears, then he immediately turns serious. He sits up straight, raises his head to face forward, and begins a formal shipwide broadcast: "Attention, everyone. At 22:00, the remote sensing survey instrument detected an anomaly in the Neutral Zone. It looks like a thunderstorm occurring in space."; the shot slowly pushes forward from a chest-up close shot to a shoulders-up close-up, with an eye-level angle and a centered composition; in the background, a middle-aged white male officer and other crew members can be seen busily moving about.
quote: Attention, everyone. At 22:00, the remote sensing survey instrument detected an anomaly in the Neutral Zone. It looks like a thunderstorm occurring in space.

text: In the vast desert canyon @scene1 on a clear summer day in the future, wind-eroded rocks and rolling sand dunes appear dry, desolate, and majestic under the sunlight. An over-the-shoulder composition is used, with the back of a woman in the foreground. In the medium shot area, a young male noble leader stands in profile; he has curly black hair and bright blue eyes, wears a desert-colored hood and combat suit, and has a frail build but a serious, resolute expression, speaking to the person in front of him. To his rear right stands a middle-aged male military advisor, with a gray-white beard and long hair tied behind his head, wearing dark armor, his weathered face fixed forward with a resolute, serious expression. The young man says seriously: "I will stay and cover your evacuation."; the image is a medium shot, over-the-shoulder composition, static shot.
quote: I will stay and cover your evacuation.

text: In the same dry, majestic desert canyon @scene1, the young female warrior is shown in a medium close-up. She has dark skin, black hair pinned up, bright blue eyes looking straight ahead, a thin tube on her nose, and wears gray armor and a combat suit, with a well-proportioned build. Her brows are slightly furrowed, and she looks ahead with eyes full of confusion and concern, her tone carrying incomprehension and worry: "What are you talking about? I can't leave you."; the image uses a centered composition, eye-level static shot.
quote: What are you talking about? I can't leave you.

text: Still against the bright desert canyon @scene1 background, an over-the-shoulder composition, with the back of the woman in the foreground. The young male noble leader turns slightly to face forward, his curly black hair and blue eyes clearly visible beneath the desert-colored hood; his expression is serious and earnest as he explains to the person in front of him. Behind him, the middle-aged male military advisor remains standing, his gray-white beard and dark armor setting off his resolute, serious face. The young man says with an earnest gaze: "Sarah, you must go. You know why."; the image is a medium shot, over-the-shoulder composition, static shot.
quote: Sarah, you must go. You know why.

text: Inside the same command center @scene1, the camera uses an over-the-shoulder angle, looking past the shoulder of Personnel One in black tactical gear. Opposite him stands a middle-aged white man with a gray-white beard, wearing a suit; his face is stern, his gaze fixed straight ahead, as he decisively gives the order: "Catch him."; the frame is a medium shot, a locked-off shot, with an over-the-shoulder composition.
quote: Catch him.

text: Inside a modern ship's cabin or research room, @scene1, the lighting is dim, and a spotlight falls on a tabletop covered with black velvet, where salvaged old objects bearing traces of mud and sand are displayed. An aged hand wearing a ring slowly enters the frame and picks up a silver handheld mirror stained with dirt from the pile of objects. Accompanied by the line "These are some of the things were covered from your state room.", the image uses an object close-up, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a diagonal composition.
quote: These are some of the things were covered from your state room.

text: Inside the same ship's cabin, @scene1, the lighting shifts to warm. An elderly woman with white hair, wearing a loose green top, sits in the center of the frame, holding the old mirror, looking at its surface with a smile of surprise and nostalgia, and says: "This is mine. Unbelievable. It looked exactly like the last time I saw it.". To her right stands a concerned young woman, while behind her is a middle-aged man leaning forward to observe; both watch her quietly. The image uses a medium close-up, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a triangular composition.
quote: This is mine. Unbelievable. It looked exactly like the last time I saw it.

text: The elderly woman turns her face to the side, her gaze lowered, her expression calm with a slight trace of sadness as she speaks with emotion about the passage of time, saying: "It's just that the person in the mirror has changed slightly.". She then slowly places the mirror in her hand back onto the tabletop covered with black cloth. The image uses a close shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: It's just that the person in the mirror has changed slightly.

text: In the modern daytime shipboard research room @scene1, the lighting is dim, with a spotlight falling on a tabletop covered in black velvet, while equipment and human silhouettes are faintly visible in the background. An aged hand slowly reaches toward the tabletop, its fingertips gently brushing over and picking up a butterfly-shaped hair comb. The old woman sighs softly: "Oh."; the image uses a close-up, an eye-level fixed camera, and a centered composition.
quote: Oh.

text: Inside the same modern ship's cabin @scene1, the middle-aged treasure hunter leans forward from behind the old woman, moving closer as he asks softly. Holding the hair comb, the old woman slowly raises her head at the sound and looks at him, their eyes meeting briefly. Then her gaze slowly shifts away, looking into the distance, as if she is preparing to begin recounting the past. The middle-aged man says intently and softly: "Are you ready to return to the Titanic? Okay, right here."; the image uses a medium close-up, an eye-level fixed camera, and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Are you ready to return to the Titanic? Okay, right here.

text: Inside the same high-tech laboratory @scene1, the wide shot uses a depth-of-field composition. On the left, the young female scientist and the elderly male scientist stand side by side in front of the control console; the woman looks at the screen and begins her report: "The system is ready," while the man beside her looks ahead with focused rigor. On the right, the middle-aged male experiment participant stands quietly with his back to the camera; his dark curly hair and black T-shirt are sharply outlined in the dim light, and he is gazing at the massive mechanical apparatus beyond the glass wall. The shot uses a static camera and an eye-level angle.
quote: The system is ready,

text: In the modern high-tech laboratory @scene1 at night, complex consoles, numerous display screens, and a huge, precisely engineered machine are clearly visible, with a glowing channel forming inside the machine. An elderly white male scientist is shown in a close shot; he has white hair and a goatee, wears glasses, and is dressed in a shirt, tie, and knitted vest, his expression focused and rigorous; he gazes toward the front right and begins reporting with a serious expression: "Coil charging."; the image uses rule-of-thirds composition, a fixed camera, and an eye-level angle.
quote: Coil charging.

text: A wide shot reveals the laboratory @scene1 at night, the atmosphere tense, with three people each in position. On the left, the young white female scientist has long dark-brown hair, wears a black top, and has an attractive face; she looks at the screen and reports: "Full power."; beside her, the elderly scientist gazes forward, while on the right, the middle-aged white male experiment participant has dark curly hair, wears a black T-shirt, and stands still with his back to the camera; the image uses deep-focus composition, a fixed camera, and an eye-level angle.
quote: Full power.

text: Inside the same modern high-tech laboratory at night @scene1, the elderly white male scientist appears in a close shot, gazing toward the front right with a focused and slightly tense expression, and calmly announces: "It's starting."; the shot uses a close shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: It's starting.

text: Inside @scene1, a modern-era ship's cabin room at night, spears and other decorations hang on the dark wooden wall paneling, the city lights outside the window cast mottled light and shadow, and vintage sofas and tables are placed throughout. A middle-aged white film producer sits in a chair; he has curly hair and full cheeks, wears a brown three-piece suit with a striped shirt and a red tie, and has an obese build. He tears a check from a checkbook, smiles as he hands it to the young white playwright standing opposite him, and says, "Take it."; The image uses a medium shot, a locked-off over-the-shoulder shot, and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Take it.

text: Inside the same modern-era ship's cabin room @scene1, the camera switches to a reverse-angle view. The young white playwright is tall, thin, and upright, wearing a fedora and a gray three-piece suit, with sharply defined facial features. He reaches out and takes the check being handed to him, looks toward the person opposite him, smiles, and says, "Thank you."; The image uses a close shot, a locked-off over-the-shoulder shot, and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Thank you.

text: In the bright, modern open-plan office @scene1, cubicle workstations and busy employees form the background. Using an over-the-shoulder composition, looking from behind the young male reporter with his back to the camera, the middle-aged Black newspaper editor-in-chief stands opposite him; he has a beard and wears glasses, dressed in a shirt with a sweater vest and tie, his expression stern and authoritative. He holds up a large newspaper sports-section proof with both hands, showing it to the other person and explaining the content on it, then says sternly: "I logged into your cloud drive to find the copy, sports section, Underdogs' Dream Shattered in Gotham, 10 Yards from Glory, and found this copy."; The frame is a medium shot, an over-the-shoulder shot, with a static camera.
quote: I logged into your cloud drive to find the copy, sports section, Underdogs' Dream Shattered in Gotham, 10 Yards from Glory, and found this copy.

text: Inside the same busy modern office @scene1, the young male reporter appears in a medium wide shot. He wears a plaid shirt and a jacket, with black-rimmed glasses, handsome black hair, and a serious, determined expression. The camera slowly tracks left from an eye-level angle as he walks down the corridor with his head lowered, with colleagues busy at work in the background. When he reaches a workstation, he stops, taking off his jacket while muttering under his breath: "But nothing about football, nothing about..."; The frame uses rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: But nothing about football, nothing about...

text: The shot cuts back inside the office @scene1, where the middle-aged Black newspaper editor-in-chief is presented in a medium shot, positioned at the center of the frame. He wears a shirt and sweater vest and glasses; at this moment, his face is twisted with anger, highly agitated and speaking through gritted teeth. Leaning against the edge of the desk, he bends forward and forcefully crumples the newspaper proof in his hands into a ball, while loudly berating toward the left side of the frame: "But nothing about football, nothing about... those friends at the Metropolis Library, only... that damn Gotham bat stuff. I told you not to chase it."; The frame is an eye-level static shot with center-point composition.
quote: But nothing about football, nothing about... those friends at the Metropolis Library, only... that damn Gotham bat stuff. I told you not to chase it.

text: In the bright office @scene1, the young male reporter is presented in a medium close shot, positioned at the center of the frame. He has taken off his jacket and wears only a plaid shirt, with black-rimmed glasses; his face is handsome and his expression serious and determined. He straightens up, raises his head to look toward the right side of the frame, his gaze showing no retreat, and begins arguing with the editor-in-chief: "The police won't help. The media has to do the right thing."; The frame is an eye-level static shot with center-point composition.
quote: The police won't help. The media has to do the right thing.

text: Inside a modern high-tech cockpit at night @scene1, the lighting is dim, with monitors all around displaying data and images of explosions. A veiny elderly man's hand first places a black square device on the console, then moves over and tightly grips the flight control stick beside it. He says calmly and intently in a low voice: "Turn on drone mode"; the shot uses a close-up of the hand, an eye-level locked-off camera, and a diagonal composition.
quote: Turn on drone mode

text: Still inside the high-tech cockpit at night @scene1, the cold glow from the screens lights up the surroundings. An elderly engineer wearing tortoiseshell-frame glasses sits in front of the control console, his body slightly angled, watching the monitors in front of him with focused calm as they display thermal-imaging targets and images of explosions. He reports calmly: "Thermal imaging shows there are twenty-four enemies on the third floor"; the shot uses a medium shot, an eye-level slow pan to the right, and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Thermal imaging shows there are twenty-four enemies on the third floor

text: Inside the same dim cockpit @scene1, the elderly engineer lowers his head slightly, the wrinkles on his face clearly visible in the faint screen glow. His expression is calm, his lips move slightly, and he softly suggests downward: "Why don't I put you on the second floor?"; the shot uses a chest-up close shot, an eye-level locked-off camera, and a center-point composition.
quote: Why don't I put you on the second floor?

text: Inside the same dim senate hall @scene1, the elderly Supreme Chancellor, with a full head of white hair and a kind yet slightly tired face, wears an ornate chancellor's robe and stands on the central presiding-dais pod. He turns sideways to the left and calmly announces: "The Chair permits the senator of the political entity of the planet Naboo to speak. The Chair permits the senator of the Kingdom of the planet Naboo to come forward and speak."; the shot uses a fixed eye-level medium shot, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: The Chair permits the senator of the political entity of the planet Naboo to speak. The Chair permits the senator of the Kingdom of the planet Naboo to come forward and speak.

text: Inside the dim senate hall @scene1, the suspended senate-seat pod carrying the senator slowly moves from the bottom of the frame to the center of the hall. With a serious expression, he faces the vast assembly and begins his speech: "Supreme Chancellor, representatives of the Senate."; the shot uses a high-angle perspective and slowly pulls back, with the shot scale gradually transitioning from a medium shot to an extreme wide shot, using central-point composition to emphasize his smallness within the vast senate space and the solemn atmosphere.
quote: Supreme Chancellor, representatives of the Senate.

text: In the dimly lit, vast circular senate hall of a future era @scene1, the walls are filled with movable floating senate pods, with a central rostrum in the middle, creating a technological and solemn atmosphere. An elderly white male senator stands on a floating senate pod, his white hair combed back, his face wrinkled, his gaze deep, wearing an ornate dark robe. He looks firmly ahead and continues delivering his speech with a serious expression, saying steadily: "A tragedy occurred when taxes were imposed on trade routes."; The image uses a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: A tragedy occurred when taxes were imposed on trade routes.

text: Inside the same dimly lit senate hall @scene1, the camera pushes in to the senator's face. Under the dim lighting, he looks straight ahead, his lips moving slightly, elaborating in detail on the cause of the tragedy with a serious expression and resolute gaze, adding in a heavy tone: "The Trade Federation has blockaded our planet."; The image uses a close shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a centered composition.
quote: The Trade Federation has blockaded our planet.

text: The perspective cuts to behind the senator; with his back to the camera, he stands on the floating senate pod, facing the distant central rostrum seats, continuing his impassioned speech, pointing out the grave threat facing the planet Naboo, his voice full of pressure: "Naboo faces a life and death threat."; The image uses a medium shot, a locked-off shot from behind, and a centered composition.
quote: Naboo faces a life and death threat.

text: Deep within the solemn senate hall @scene1, a floating senate pod slowly moves forward. Standing on the pod is a Neimoidian Trade Federation representative, with green skin, red eyes, no nose, wearing a tall black hat and a dark robe, tall and thin, his posture guarded and irritable, preparing to refute, sharply interrupting: "That is not true!"; The image uses a wide shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a centered composition.
quote: That is not true!

text: In @scene1, a modern attic art studio on a sunny day, sunlight streams in through a huge arched window, and the interior is filled with books, paintings, easels, and desks, with picture frames covering the walls, while an old-fashioned television in the corner adds a somewhat cluttered yet warm artistic atmosphere. A young white woman sits on the sofa, wearing a green cardigan and a dark dress, her short dark hair setting off her slender, delicate face. She holds a white bowl in both hands, eating the food one spoonful at a time with a calm expression. She murmurs softly: "Eventually she couldn't stand the gossip and backbiting..."; the image uses a chest-up close shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a center composition.
quote: Eventually she couldn't stand the gossip and backbiting...

text: Inside the same sunlit art studio @scene1, the young white woman sits with her back to the camera on the sofa in the foreground. In the middle ground, a middle-aged white male artist rises from in front of the easel; he wears glasses, has short gray-white hair, and is dressed in a white shirt, a patterned tie, and a beige vest, with a well-proportioned, slightly plump build. He is about to walk toward the sofa. She continues: "...and decided to leave..."; the image is a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, with depth composition.
quote: ...and decided to leave...

text: The shot cuts back to a chest-up close shot of the young white woman, still holding the white bowl and chewing slowly. After hearing the sound, she slowly raises her head, her gaze turning toward the right side of the frame, a trace of searching in her eyes, her expression still calm. She continues: "...to quit the entertainment industry."; the image uses an eye-level locked-off shot and a center composition.
quote: ...to quit the entertainment industry.

text: In the bright art studio @scene1, the artist stands on the right side of the frame, smiling as he raises a framed painting with both hands and shows it to the young white woman seated on the left. The young white woman looks up at him and the painting. The artist gently teases: "As a piece of bad work,this isn't bad."; the image is a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: As a piece of bad work,this isn't bad.

text: In the restaurant back kitchen @scene1 on a modern autumn daytime, the light is dim, the background is piled with kitchenware and ingredients and filled with steam, and the atmosphere is tense. A middle-aged scientist wearing a long black trench coat and gold-rimmed glasses places a black notebook on the table. The bald elderly agent chief sitting by the table picks up the notebook and opens it, his movement continuous and his expression focused. The camera pushes in to a close-up of the notebook; the left page is filled with English writing, and the right page shows a head sketch of a humanoid monster. The bald man points at the page and says, "And, where the test subjects are being held…"; the image uses a medium shot, a locked-off camera, and a close-up composition from an overhead angle.
quote: And, where the test subjects are being held…

text: Inside the same dim back kitchen @scene1, the camera shifts to an overhead locked-off partial extreme close-up. The bald man's hand turns the notebook page, and the new page clearly displays several detailed sketches of the monster's hand structure and webbing. He adds in a calm and authoritative voice, "The laboratory map, everything needed to rescue the test subjects, it's all here."; the image uses a close-up composition from an overhead angle.
quote: The laboratory map, everything needed to rescue the test subjects, it's all here.

text: Still in the back kitchen @scene1, the shot uses an over-the-shoulder angle. In the foreground is the back of the scientist wearing the black trench coat; in the medium shot, the bald man closes the notebook, picks up a blue file beside it, looks up at the scientist, and speaks, his movements steady. He says in a decisive tone, "I will submit these to headquarters. We need to act as soon as possible."; the image is a medium shot, an over-the-shoulder shot, with depth-of-field composition.
quote: I will submit these to headquarters. We need to act as soon as possible.

text: Inside the same back kitchen @scene1, the atmosphere is grave. The scientist wearing the black trench coat stands on the right side of the frame, holding a hat in his hand, looking seriously at the bald man sitting by the table on the left and another blond, bearded, powerfully built agent. The bald man has his back to the camera, and the agent is in profile to the camera. The scientist emphasizes in a firm tone, "We need to act as soon as possible."; the image is a medium shot, a locked-off camera, with rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: We need to act as soon as possible.

text: Inside the dim warehouse @scene1 on a modern night, interlaced red and blue lighting creates a sense of oppression, and a car covered with a red cloth is visible in the background. A young Black male agent sits beside a gridded glass wall; he has dark skin, a thick beard, and short hair, wears a dark jacket with orange bands on the sleeves, looks warily toward the right side of the frame, and asks, "Wheeler, go take a look over there."; The shot uses a close shot, an eye-level static shot, and rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Wheeler, go take a look over there.

text: Inside the same dim warehouse @scene1, red and blue lighting intertwines. A middle-aged white male soldier wears full tactical gear, has a black beret on his head, and stands holding a rifle. He has white skin, a brown beard, a sharp gaze, and a serious expression; his head turns slightly, and he decisively gives the order: "Follow me."; The shot uses a medium shot, an eye-level static shot, and center-point composition.
quote: Follow me.

text: The shot cuts back to the young Black male agent. He is still sitting beside the gridded glass wall; under the red and blue lighting, his eyes widen, his face shows surprise and confusion, and he looks ahead and asks, "Where did he go?"; The shot uses a close shot, an eye-level static shot, and center-point composition.
quote: Where did he go?

text: The middle-aged white male soldier maintains his gun-holding posture, looks ahead with a serious expression in the red atmosphere, and commands coldly, "Go over there."; The shot uses a medium shot, an eye-level static shot, and center-point composition.
quote: Go over there.

text: Using over-the-shoulder composition and a close shot, a locked-off shot films from behind the elderly alchemist. His back is to the camera, his gaze falls on the old photo album in front of him, staring at the photo inside, his lips parting and closing slightly as he says in a grave low voice: "What happened? Everything he said has happened."
quote: What happened? Everything he said has happened.

text: The frame cuts back to a side-view medium shot of the elderly alchemist, a locked-off shot, with rule-of-thirds composition. The fingers of both his hands are interlaced and clenched tightly, his eyes looking toward the front right, his expression serious and tense, his lips parting and closing as he continues speaking: "Grindelwald is holding a gathering at the cemetery tonight, and by then someone will die."
quote: Grindelwald is holding a gathering at the cemetery tonight, and by then someone will die.

text: In the modern-day nighttime forest @scene1, a campfire burns, the surrounding trees are dense, the light is dim, and the atmosphere is solemn. An elderly white-haired man is shown in a shoulders-up close-up; he wears a dark turtleneck top and a dark red cloak, his face is wrinkled but his eyes are sharp, and his bearing is commanding. His expression is serious, his lips move slightly, and he gazes ahead with depth, as if waiting for the other person's reaction, calmly saying: "Wait a moment."; the shot uses a fixed eye-level camera, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Wait a moment.

text: In the same nighttime forest @scene1, under the glow of the campfire, a young Black woman is shown in a shoulders-up close-up. She has short white hair with straight bangs, dark skin, and well-defined features, and wears a black zip-up jacket. She raises her head and looks directly toward the front-left, her face showing clear confusion, and asks: "How did Stryker know where to find the Mastermind?"; the frame uses a fixed eye-level camera, with a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: How did Stryker know where to find the Mastermind?

text: Still in the dim forest @scene1, the campfire light flickers across the elderly white-haired man's face. He first lowers his head in silence, then after a moment raises his head and looks toward the front-left, his expression calm and resolute, admitting: "I told him."; the shot is a chest-up close shot, with a fixed eye-level camera and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: I told him.

text: In @scene1, a town street in Atlanta on a sunny summer day in the modern era, the background is brick buildings and horse-drawn carriages, with a dense crowd of people in 19th-century-style clothing gathered in front of a huge arched building (resembling a train station). In an extreme wide high-angle shot, the dark mass of people is vast in scale and filled with agitation and chaos, while the announcement of "casualty lists..." echoes through the air; the shot uses a locked-off camera and a horizontal composition.
quote: casualty lists...

text: The image cuts to a partial extreme close-up of the casualty lists, and the camera slowly tilts downward, clearly showing that the densely packed names on the lists are each marked with "Killed in action" (killed in action), while the crowd's grief-stricken cries intertwine in the background, creating an extremely sorrowful atmosphere; the shot uses a vertical composition.
quote: Killed in action

text: Still in the softly lit villa veranda, @scene1, the young male musician appears again in a chest-up close-up with a center-point composition. Facing the woman's mockery, his expression looks somewhat awkward and helpless; he gently shakes his head, looks at the woman opposite him, and denies it: "It seems not"; the frame maintains a locked-off camera, filmed at eye level.
quote: It seems not

text: In the same scene, @scene1, the young woman continues to appear in a chest-up close-up with a rule-of-thirds composition, filmed with a locked-off camera at eye level. With a relaxed smile on her face, she looks at the man opposite her, continues joking, and makes a request: "Can you lend me your clothes?"; she is still holding the drink can in her hand.
quote: Can you lend me your clothes?

text: Inside the same modern music studio at night, @scene1, the lead singer is singing passionately. The elderly photographer appears annoyed and angry because the camera in his hands suddenly malfunctions; he walks briskly out of frame to take a new camera from an assistant, then turns back while complaining and continues directing the set, pointing first at the trumpeter and then at the bassist, his movements impatient. He shouts loudly: "Give me another camera! What's wrong with this one? The damn camera isn't working, what's going on! Okay, trumpeter, nice pose."; The shot uses a medium shot, an eye-level tracking shot, and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Give me another camera! What's wrong with this one? The damn camera isn't working, what's going on! Okay, trumpeter, nice pose.

text: The camera quickly pans from left to right inside the same music studio, @scene1, showing a wide shot of the drummer, bassist, and other band members playing, and finally freezes on a man standing off to one side. He wears a white hat and sunglasses, standing there with a calm expression. An approving voice comes from offscreen: "Okay, fantastic, fantastic!"; The shot uses an eye-level pan and a rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Okay, fantastic, fantastic!

text: Still in the dimly lit music studio, @scene1, the elderly photographer wears a satisfied smile, turned sideways to the camera, happily waving to the band members on the right to show his approval. He continues praising them: "Okay, fantastic, fantastic!"; The shot uses a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a center-point composition.
quote: Okay, fantastic, fantastic!

text: In a dimly lit modern music studio at night, @scene1, a stage, a drum kit, a bass, and decorative paintings are visible in the background, creating a retro atmosphere full of artistic flair. A young white male musician in a black suit keeps his head lowered and walks toward an electronic keyboard with red keys. He places both hands on the keys, his fingers moving gracefully, and begins to play a soothing melody with a focused expression. At this moment, the voiceover urges, "Play something, anything. You play the piano, don't you? Play something."; the shot uses a medium shot transitioning to a close-up, a high-angle locked-off shot, and a diagonal composition.
quote: Play something, anything. You play the piano, don't you? Play something.

text: Inside the same dimly lit music studio, @scene1, the young male musician continues to play the electronic keyboard with focus, while camera flashes flicker around him from time to time. As the music continues, he slowly raises his head and looks ahead with a calm expression. The voiceover praises, "Very good, beautiful, very good, very good."; the shot uses a close shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a centered composition.
quote: Very good, beautiful, very good, very good.

text: Still in the retro music studio, @scene1, the young male musician keeps his head raised, calmly gazing ahead, while both hands continue playing on the electronic keyboard, with a pair of sunglasses quietly placed beside him. The voiceover encourages him, "Don't stop, keep playing, keep going, keep playing, very good."; the shot uses a close shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a centered composition.
quote: Don't stop, keep playing, keep going, keep playing, very good.

text: Inside the same music studio, @scene1, the young male musician still keeps his head raised, continuing to play the electronic keyboard with a calm expression. Accompanied by a crisp shutter click and a flash lighting up, the image freezes on the moment he is playing. The voiceover says softly, "Very good."; the shot uses a close shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and a centered composition.
quote: Very good.

text: Inside the same dim interrogation room @scene1, the shot switches to an over-the-shoulder, eye-level static shot, using a rule-of-thirds composition and focusing on a chest-up close shot of a middle-aged male police officer. He wears a black suit, a white shirt, and a tie, with rimless glasses, neat hair, and a refined face. He holds a pen horizontally against his mouth, his sharp gaze fixed on the criminal smoking to the front left, saying nothing yet full of pressure and implication, as if waiting for a storm to arrive. He calmly asks, "How about it?"
quote: How about it?

text: The shot cuts to a close-up of the criminal's face, an eye-level frontal static shot with a centered composition. He wears a black suit jacket over a floral shirt, with a weathered face, stubble, a downturned mustache, and short hair that looks slightly messy. The originally tense and wary criminal suddenly erupts emotionally, his eyes widening sharply, his mouth opening, and he shouts angrily with all his strength, "Go!", still holding a cigarette between his fingers, revealing the enormous shock inside him.
quote: Go!

text: The frame returns once again to an over-the-shoulder, eye-level static shot with a rule-of-thirds composition, presenting a chest-up close shot of the police officer. Facing the roar of the criminal opposite him, his expression remains completely unruffled, and he still calmly holds the pen against his mouth, his eyes quietly watching the agitated person to the front left; the strong contrast between movement and stillness highlights his steady sense of control. The police officer's tone grows heavier as he says with unquestionable pressure, "I'm telling you to go, do you hear me?"
quote: I'm telling you to go, do you hear me?

text: Inside the futuristic daytime spaceship lounge @scene1, the space is open and brightly lit, furnished with white futuristic tables and chairs, with the vast universe visible outside the windows. A middle-aged white male astronaut bends over with his head lowered, meticulously tightening components on an improvised bomb with a tool, carrying out the final reinforcement; a young white female astronaut quietly observes from the side, her expression focused and calm. The male astronaut says steadily: "Its power is 5 times that of an explosive."; The image uses a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and rule-of-thirds composition, with the two people positioned on opposite sides and the device in the middle serving as the visual center.
quote: Its power is 5 times that of an explosive.

text: In the same spaceship interior @scene1, the shot cuts to a close-up, focusing on the two people's hands working together. The middle-aged male astronaut uses both hands to forcefully tighten the valve of the improvised bomb, his movements focused and strong; the young female astronaut's hand steadily supports another piece of equipment from the side. The female astronaut asks calmly: "How are we going to detonate it?"; The image uses a close-up, an eye-level locked-off shot, and center-point composition, with the focus concentrated on the hand movements and the key device.
quote: How are we going to detonate it?

text: Still inside the bright spaceship lounge @scene1, the middle-aged male astronaut lifts the completed improvised bomb and steadily hands it to the young female astronaut opposite him, while explaining the detonation method. The female astronaut reaches out with a serious expression to take it, and the male astronaut asks: "Can you connect this to the lighting panel?"; The image uses a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off shot, and symmetrical composition, with the two people standing on opposite sides and the bomb being passed between them becoming the visual center.
quote: Can you connect this to the lighting panel?

text: In the dim retro café @scene1 on a modern summer night, framed pictures hang on the walls, and the checkerboard floor tiles and simple tables and chairs create a strong period feel. On the left side of the frame, an elderly mob boss with a heavy build, slicked-back hair, a low-crowned fedora, a striped shirt, and suspenders leans forward, holding a cigar in his right hand as he gestures, speaking seriously to the right side. On the right side of the frame, an elderly mob member with graying hair, black-rimmed glasses, a dark suit, and a blue shirt also leans forward, listening intently. The elderly mob boss says in a serious, steady voice: ""I'm going to tell you what I told them. I don't approve of Pro talking to Jimmy like that.""; the shot uses a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off camera, and rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: I'm going to tell you what I told them. I don't approve of Pro talking to Jimmy like that.

text: Inside the same dim retro café @scene1, three elderly men sit around a small table, with a moka pot placed in the center of the table. On the left side of the frame, an elderly mob member with graying hair, a pronounced slicked-back hairstyle, a burgundy suit, and a plaid shirt leans forward, speaking toward the middle. In the middle of the frame, the heavyset mob boss wearing a low-crowned fedora and, on the right side of the frame, the elderly member wearing black-rimmed glasses and a dark suit are both watching him, all three with serious expressions. He says seriously and deferentially: ""Who talks that way about someone's grandchildren.""; the shot uses a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off camera, and triangular composition.
quote: Who talks that way about someone's grandchildren.

text: The shot cuts back to a two-person medium shot inside the dim café @scene1. The heavyset mob boss on the left is still leaning forward, holding a cigar and gesturing, continuing to express his view with a serious expression. The elderly mob member on the right looks at him intently, listening carefully. The mob boss says calmly and decisively: ""That's wrong.""; the shot uses a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off camera, and rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: That's wrong.

text: In the dim retro café @scene1, the three elderly men sit together again. The heavyset mob boss in the middle crosses his arms over the back of the chair, leans forward, and speaks seriously to the right side. The elderly member on the right wearing black-rimmed glasses listens carefully. The elderly member on the left wearing a burgundy suit lowers his head and looks at the tabletop, the atmosphere among the three of them grave. The mob boss says with authority and composure: ""But Pro is not a nobody. Jimmy should know that.""; the shot uses a medium shot, an eye-level locked-off camera, and triangular composition.
quote: But Pro is not a nobody. Jimmy should know that.

text: In the modern nighttime industrial-style apartment @scene1, exposed red-brick walls and slightly cluttered furnishings create an oppressive atmosphere. A young white male reporter lies comfortably on the sofa, with both hands pillowed behind his head, his body stretched back, watching the football game on TV with a relaxed expression. He casually praises it, saying, "Great. He rushes too fast and the offensive line can't stop him."; the image uses a long shot, fixed camera, eye-level angle, and rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: Great. He rushes too fast and the offensive line can't stop him.

text: Inside the same dim apartment @scene1, the TV image suddenly switches to breaking news. When the young white male reporter sees it, he immediately sits upright from his reclining position, leans forward, stares intently at the screen, and his expression shifts from relaxed to serious. A broadcast comes from the TV: "The hunt for the suspect Jack is on the run... a manhunt begins across the state..."; the image uses a medium shot, fixed camera, eye-level angle, and centered composition.
quote: The hunt for the suspect Jack is on the run... a manhunt begins across the state...

text: In the oppressive apartment @scene1, the young white male reporter quickly gets up from the sofa, his back to the camera, and strides toward the TV ahead that is playing the news. The background audio continues: "...Manhunt launched across the state..."; the image uses a medium wide shot, fixed camera, eye-level angle, and centered composition.
quote: ...Manhunt launched across the state...

text: In @scene1, a modern, dimly lit home office at night, exposed red-brick walls and venetian blinds are faintly visible, and the cluttered large desk is piled with documents and blueprints, with only one desk lamp providing the main light source. A middle-aged white male reporter appears in a close shot with an over-the-shoulder composition; he has short hair, stubble on his face, wears a dark long-sleeved T-shirt, and looks anxious yet focused. He carefully examines a card covered with red patterns in both hands, muttering to himself in confusion, then sets the card down, picks up another drawing with a winged pattern and handwritten words, and studies it intently. He murmurs in confusion: "I don't understand. Layer upon layer of hell... the church on the hill is deathly silent. It's all because of you. You and I are the same kind. There is only a glimmer of hope."; The shot uses a close shot, a fixed over-the-shoulder shot, and an over-the-shoulder shot composition.
quote: I don't understand. Layer upon layer of hell... the church on the hill is deathly silent. It's all because of you. You and I are the same kind. There is only a glimmer of hope.

text: In the same dimly lit office @scene1, he continues to appear in a close shot with an over-the-shoulder composition. He raises the drawing with the winged angel pattern and ribbon text in both hands, his gaze locked tightly on the image, his expression growing increasingly focused. As if lost in thought, he murmurs softly: "Twisted inside, 'you are a glimmer of hope.' Hope."; The image maintains a fixed over-the-shoulder shot and an over-the-shoulder shot composition.
quote: Twisted inside, 'you are a glimmer of hope.' Hope.

text: The shot cuts to a close-up of his face, with the background still the dimly lit office @scene1. He knits his brows, narrows his eyes, his lips slightly parted, his facial expression filled with confusion and frustration as he struggles to sort through the clues in his mind. He says softly with emotion: "You feel like home to me, like family."; The shot uses a fixed camera position and center-point composition, emphasizing the character's inner struggle and emotional stirring.
quote: You feel like home to me, like family.

text: Returning to a close over-the-shoulder perspective, the middle-aged white male reporter raises another drawing in the dimly lit office @scene1. The drawing clearly depicts a large tree and a Gothic-style building; he studies the details of the image intently, his expression still grave. He repeats softly once more: "You feel like home to me, like family."; The shot maintains a fixed over-the-shoulder shot and an over-the-shoulder shot composition.
quote: You feel like home to me, like family.

text: The shot cuts back to the elderly male slave's face; he lowers his head, his gaze locked tightly on the ore in his hands, his eyes filled with both despair and rekindled hope, and with an excited expression he opens his mouth and shouts in a trembling yet firm voice: "Eternal ore!" The image uses a close-up, an eye-level fixed shot, and center-point composition.
quote: Eternal ore!

text: In the retro-style bathroom @scene1 on a sunny summer day in the present day, the lower half is a pink tile wall, the upper half is green diamond-patterned wallpaper, harsh sunlight shines through behind the pink curtains, and above the washbasin is a mirror with tube lights. The shot uses an over-the-shoulder angle, with the back of a middle-aged white man's head in the foreground and his reflection in the mirror in the midground. His face is haggard, with protruding cheekbones and deep-set eyes, he is wearing white underwear, and with a pained expression he raises his head to look at the mirror, squeezes green hair dye into his hand, and vigorously rubs his hair. He mutters to himself, "This is life."; the image is a close shot, with an over-the-shoulder shot paired with a locked-off camera, using depth-of-field composition.
quote: This is life.

text: Inside the same retro bathroom @scene1, the shot changes to a close-up of the middle-aged man's face, using a side-angle locked-off camera. His face and hair are covered in green hair dye, and as he scratches at his hair with his hand, he turns his face to look toward the right front, the corners of his mouth stretching open into an eerie and smug smile, his expression deranged. He says in a low voice, "That's what people say."; the image uses rule-of-thirds composition.
quote: That's what people say.
